LiAITFJLAXa KA HOK LONGTRAI KA SAH TYNGKAI BAD U NONGTHOH KA SIEN SHON KABA NYNGKONG. La pynmih da I Kong Hcsila Pyngrope, Rngi Jynriew, Nongthymmai, Shillong. La, la pyishang ban leh bniah katba lah, pynban ka lait ka lymbiang ka byllai; kumta u Nongthoh u pdiang da kaba sngewnguh ia kino-kino ki jingkdew ban kham pynbha ia kane ka Kitab ha ki por ki ban dang wan. KA KTIEN LAMPHRANG Ka jingthmu kaba kongsan ha kaba thoh ia kine ki jingthoh, ka long kurano ban kyntiew ia la ka ri bad ka jaitbynriew lyngba ka thoh ka pule. Naduh dang khynnah, la ju iohsngew ba kiba rangbah ki ialap-iariew shaphang ka jingkyrduh ki kot khasi. Kane ka jingpyrkhat ka la bat bad saiiidur ia ka jingmut naduh

kata ka por. Ynda la kham san, ka la iiang jur ka jingangnud ban thoh kot bad la kut jingmut ba dei ban leh ei-ei da lade ne ban bah wait lyngngun da lade. Ka jingpyrshang ban lum jingtip lyngba ki jingthoh ka long 1 a kam kaba jwat ; hynrei ka nang kham jwat shuh-shuh lada c’ei ban lum na ki briew kiba shu tipktien-tip pateng. Te khnang ban kham lashai lehse kan biang hi kat ban ring nuksa bad pyn- sriem malu-mala ba ka long kum u briew uba wad uba thud ban lap ia ka jaka badon ne shong mawpyrsut. Ynda u la lap, u hap pat ban tih ban shrot, ban khlong ban khlaw bad ban pyntuid- pyakit ia u mawpyrsut sha ki wah. Ynda u la kie ha ki wah, donkam pat banjiarban snaid pateng-pateng, ban phleng ban pynkhuid haduh ba un da pliah bad bit ban leit lam sha ka shlem- sain-nar. Shuwa ban saifi pat, donkam biang ban da mang ban da thew ban da dong ban sain-pynum ha ka ding barhein ka pa- jvva haduh ba un da man narliang-narwah. Na une u nar-liang narwah pat, ki kamar bad ki nongshoh-thaw ki sa sain-pynwan- dur ha ka shloin jong ki ban shna ia ki wait ki tari, ki mohkhiew bad kiwei kiwei de ki tiar kiba donkam. Ym dei pat ruh ban klet ba ha kum kane ka jaid jingtrei, ka hoit ka jaw, ka tait ka bret, ka khoh ka phler, ka phret ka phrong kaba byllai. Don ki jingeh kiba mih na ka daw ba ki jingtip ki shong saphret saphnang ha kylleng ka ri, kumta ba hap ban khar ban tarn ban lum shitom shidkhoi nangne shidkhot pat nangtai. Don pat ba ki jirgtip ki shong thup shong thiar kum ki shyieng bun

jait bun syrtap hapoh ka krem ka kroh, ka synrang ne ka thwei. Kumta ka la shim por slem-slem ban lah ban jied ban sot ban pyndait lang biang-pa-biang kat ban saindur ha kawei ka shruh ne ka shynrong (skeleton). Don ki jingtip kiba la shu ioh sriem kumba khalai-nusib ; ne long sriem kumba bthah ki tyramen, ba, ‘lada phi kwah ban ioh jingsiad, leit tong urn na wah ha ka por ne ka khyllipmat ba kawah ka iohthiah’. Don ki ricwtymmen kiba hadien slem-slem, ba la pyrsbang shitom, la lah shisha ban ioh iakynduh bad ia- shongkai bad ki. Hynrei kaba diaw ka long ba ka sien-shongkai kaba nyngkong (kaba teng-teng ka neh tang da ki minit) ka long artad ka sienshong-kai kaba khatduh. Haba jia kumne, poi haba jnang, namar shaei pat yn leit wad jingshai. Jar la katta ruh, ha ka jingbymbanse, la hap hi ban shu tare kulmar bad ban pyrshang ban batai tang katba lah ei ban shemphang. Kane ka pynkyn- II maw ia uta u tymmen Sohra uba ong, “Ynda la poi ha u pud uba nga ia lade ruh ngam lah sngewthuh shuh, to ieh nga mat shu tharai, nangta ngan sa batai^ bad phi lah ban ong ia nga, u ‘TharaUbataV ”, Kumba la kdew shakhmat, ki jingeh ha ka jinglum jingtip ki long kiba bun syrtap. Kawei na kita ka long ba don ki riew-tip- tymmen, hynrei ki lah pat ban batai tang ha ka ktien shnong. Nalor nangta, ki don ki ktien kiba ha ka ktien kot ki don kawei ka jingmut, katba ha ka ktien shnong pat ki kit da kawei ka jing-

mut. Ka jingkylla ha ki juk bad ki por ruh ka wallam ia ka jing- kylla ha ki briew. Ha ki juk kiba ia leit noh, paidbah kiei-kiei ki long sngur long synlar. Ki briew ruh dang bun kiba kren kumba ki mut bad ki mut ruh kumba ki kren. Hynrei katba nangiaid ki por bad katba ki briew ki nang kam ialade kum kiba la kham long riewshai (civilised) katta la nang duna ka jinglong- sngur ka jinglong-nylla. Katba nangiaid ki por nang jur ki musli-musla, nangrben ka tahrong-tahrup, haduh u pud ba mar shisien jngoh ne shisien madj la shitom ban ithuh ne sngewthuh kano kaba nylla bad kano pat kaba tang na sla. Ka plie lad bad ka khanglad ki iaiaid synrap kumba thain pi-ar. Ha bym pat lait surok kali, bun kiei-kiei ki sah nylla ki sah synlar, hynrei ban leit Jngoh ia ki ka long kaba shitom. Hyn- rei ynda la lait kali pat, ka leit ka wan ka la suk shibun tangba bun kiei-kiei ki la kylla dur bak-ly-bak, bad slem ka ktien, don napdeng Jong ki kiba la i kumba kin duh jait noh syndon. Nang lait surok, nang synlen ki khlaw, nang iwa ki lum, nang rwa u shyiap, nang duna u maw, nang jngut ki wah, nang iwkhong ka Iyer, nang rngad ki umtong-umdih. Don jaka-jaka kiba la Iwcl Iko hi pom sriem kumba hap bom ; don pat kiba la khynra pyn- kylla khongpong naduh tynrai sriem kumba khynniuh jumai. Teng-teng sngew kumba phohsniew ban iohi ba don ki khlaw kiba la ju iaid kjat da ki lai sngi saw sngi lynti pynban plain-ly-lain ki kylla lyndum tangbapoh khyndiat por khyndiat sngi. Ki dieng

shi-piam-star ar-piam-star kiba la ieng rangbah jwaih kum ki syiem, ki lyngdoh ha ki lum bad ki them, la shu pam, shu ot, shu khet jubor khlem por khlem samoi. Ki skul ki la nang bun katba nang iaid ki sngi, bad don jaka-jaka ba ki la mih kumba jei ne ba ki la shu mih pathar kum ki tit. Ba ki jia ne ki wan ki jingkylla ym da don eh shibun ban da sngewphylla. Lajan baroh kiei-kiei ki kylla na ka por sha ka por, bad lehse kawei na ki bymjukylla ka long ka ain jong ki jing- kylla. Lada don ei-ei kaba kham phylla, kata ka long ka Jing- kylla stet jong kiei-kiei kaba ym ju ialap-iariew naduh ki juk kiba mynshuwa. Ki jingkylla kiba stet eh ki dei khamtam kito kiba la wan rah lyngba ka Science bad ka Technology. Ill KA JINGIM KA LONG KA JINGPYRSHANG Man la ka Aiom man la ka Por, ki don hi la ka khubor, ki don hi la ka antor. Ki juk ki wan bad ki juk ki leit. Ki pateng ki mih bad ki pateng ki jah. Ha la ka sap ka phong, ha la ba long ba long, ka bha hi katba lah, ban pyrshang shitom ban ia- iap-iariew pateng katba iohlad bad ban tip syn-ei. Ka bha ruh ban pyrshang ban lur ha la la i nur ryngkat ka jingkyrmen ba U Trai Nongthaw Un pynsei-soh sei-symbai, Un pynman thning pynman snap na ka bynta ki pateng ki ban dang wan ha ka lyngkha kaba iar jong ka ri bad ka jait bynriew. Lajan kut (baroh) ki kam, ki dawa lakuinnokuranoia kawei na kine lada ym haroh, kata ia ka por, ka bor, bad ka pisa.

Kumta ka long kaba eh, ia uba bun uba lang, ban leh bniah ha kano kano ka jingpyrshang kaba u trei raon sngewbha khlem bai- siew-baiseng ne khlem kano kano ka kynja scholarship. La sngewdei ban da ban khnang ia kane namar ha kane ka jjngpyr- shang, ki lah ban don ki bynta kiba ki Longdien ki lah ban pyr- khai ba la shu leh mata-madei ne leh tad-dep. Ka daw kaba kongsan eh, ka long namar ba la shu thohknieh-thohkynrup ryngkat ka syier ioh ba kumei-kumci, u Jingiap u lap ba kynthet noh ia ki Longshuwa ki Manshuwa, shuwa ba kin ang kin khlei pateng ia ka jingtip jong ki, ne ia u Nonglura-jingtip hi. Ha kane ka jait jingtrei, la pyrshang shitom ban lum ia ki laiphew har rukom ki plingit jingtip kiba iathain kyrwoh naduh u khla u thlen, uksuidukhrei, UTrai Nongbuh U Trai Nongthaw, ki blei ki dken, ka suifi ka Iyer, ka sngi u bnai, ki khlur, ka kpoh-ramew, ka kpoh-niamra bad katba lah ban tda shaduh lyn- det tyngkong ka sngi u bnai ne wat shaduh sha shakiar kajing- mutdur. La phriang hangne ia ki laiphewjait ki subject da ka jing- khmih lynti ba ki nongpule kin ioh lad ban iashim bynta Jang, ban iataw mar shi-kyntien ar-kyntien ne wat tang ban shu mad ne thoh tiak kumba thoh mluh. Ka jingtip, tang ka jingtip kam biang, la la lum ia ki jing- tip na kylleng ki trep bad ki skum. U nongthoh u kynmaw kyn- diang ba, ki tiar-shna-iing, la u sder ne phlang, u dieng u siej, ka lyntang ka thaboh, ka tin ka saraw, u maw-it u maw-blok, u

mawria u shyiap ne ka dew-bilat bad kiwei kiwei kiba kum kita, kim dei satia ka iing^ kim dei satia ka jingtei. Kumjuh ruh ka doh ne ka dohkha, ka khi ka uinphniang, ujingshoh, ka mluh, ki musli-musla bad kiwei kiwei de ki jnir shet^jyntah, kim dei satia ka jyntah, Ki ktien, ki sentens, ki dak sangeh, ki kyrteng briew bad kiwei-kiwei kim dei ka drama lane ka novel. Baroh kiei-kiei IV kl don la ki rukom la ka bait, ki don la ka ain la ka adong kiba donkam ban bud bniah bud ryntih ia ki^ khnang ban pynieng ia ka jingtei ne pynman ia ka jyntah, ne saindur ia ka drama. Kine pat ruh ki shong shikatdei ch ha ki kti uba lip uba nang ban shna ban saindur katba kum ka jingbit bad ka jingtbit jong u. Katba dangsah ha kane ka them ki um-mat, hateng-hateng ki wan shoh ki er-iong ka sukha ka dukha mynsiein bad ki er- lang-thari ka diaw bad ka blaw, hynrei ha uba Jah ban ap, iai- shah bad kyrmen, ki wan bch pat ruh ki er-batemon ka tngen bad ki er-batesi ka kmea. Kine ki pasiaw jein jai-jai ba, haba y.ii pat ioh paki-dulan, nang rich ha i trep i skum kyndob-madob, haba ym pat lait surok-kali, nang jam shitom thop-shi-thop ha ka lynti-khasi, namar kiei-kiei baroh ki don la ka dor, ha la ka hud, bad ka por. Ha ka por hyndai ka ju long ka rukom ba ki kynja riewtym- men bad ki riewtip-tymmen ki ju iathuhthaw-iathuhtang ha la ki khun ki ksiew ia ki jingtip kiba kordor ba ki la lum na la ki long- shuwa ki manshuwa. Ki khun ki ksiew ruh ki shah shkor kyn-

diang, ki kynshcw ki kyndiap, ki ri ki sumar kyndong khnang ba kin lah ban ai pateng pat ha ki pateng kiba bud. Hynrei suki- suki katba ki briew ki nang tip kot-tipsla ki lakham iabeh satang ia ki jingthoh. Teng-teng ki da kynnoh ruh, ‘khlem jinglhoh, khlem dulir, te yn leit long shano ?’ Ka ktien-kren (spoken woid) ka la shong per bad ka la her noh. Sa tang ka ktien-thoh (written word) kaba kham neh. Kawei na ki jingpyrshang jong u Nongthoh, ka long ba la ialeh shitom katba lah ban thoh tlem-thoh nylla ha katta ka ru- kom ba kiei-kiei kin paw haka dur kumba ki long. Kam pher la ki itynnat ibhabriew, jyllad-lymphuin kum u liew-myngngor kyl- lai-lyngsyun^ ne ki sniewbriew-sniewjcw sohkhroh-sohbroh kum ka hynroh. Na kaia ka daw la kiar katba Jah na ka thoh pynrem ne thoh pynksan, thoh-beift ne thoh-iaroh thoh-pynheh ne thoh- pynrit, thoh-khroh ne ihoh-bymsalia, ne kano-kano ka rukom thoh kaba lah ban mih na ka jingmut-jngut. Haduh katno kane ka jingpyrshang ka kynjoh sha katci ka jingthmu, ka shong ha ki nongpule ban bishar. Na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi jong ki paidbah nongpule kiba ym pat ju pule ia kine ki jait jingthoh mynshuwa, u nongthoh u la sngewdei ban shon hangne ia kine ki kyntieii kiba long kum ka nongrim bad ka jingpynshai ia kiba bun ki jingthoh kiba la kyn- thup hapoh kane ka kitab. ^"Ka jingmut jong kiba bun kiei-kiei ka shong shibun eh ha ka rukom ba la pynkylla ne batai (interpret) ia ki^ katba kum kajing-

iapher ki por bad ki jaka*\ V Ha kanc ka Ri Laiphew Syiem-Khatar-doloi, ka long kaei- kaei kaba eh katta-katta ban pyrshang ban ai kano-kano ka kyn- ja jingbatai kaba long salonsar kat ban biang ban khlup (cover) ia ka Ri baroh kawei. Ka daw ka long namar don bun kiei-kiei kiba iapher na kawei ka ilaka bad kawei pat, na kawei ka thain bad kawei pat, bad don ka jingiapher wat ha ka rukom-ring-sur ne kynnoh ia ki ktien na shiliang-wah sha shiliang-wah ne na shiliang-lum sha shiliang-lum. Kumta bunsien lada don kiba ong — ‘Sha ka thain jong ngi neshaka ilaka jong ngi, ki leh kumta- kumta; kiwei pat ki ong, sha ka thain jong ngi ne sha ka ilaka jong ngi pat kirn leh satia kunlta^ Ha kane ka rukom, kaei kaba la niew kum kaba bit kaba biang kaba iahap ia kawei ka thain, ka lah pat ban ym bit, ym biang, ym iahap ia kawei pat ka thain. La la pyrshang shitom ban kham bniah, pynban u nongthoh u sngewihuh ba ki jingbatai ki jngai ia ka jingjanai, hynrei u khmih lynti ba la kumno-kumno kin biang tang kum ka pruid- dak bad ka prat-Iynti. U Nongthoh u pynpaw ka jingsngewnguh ia baroh ki Long- shuwa ki Manshuwa (khlcm da hiewtang), kiba Jadaym dei daka jingiarap phylliew-jingtip jong ki, yn ym lah satia ban thoh ia kane ka kitab. U pynpaw ka jingsngewnguh kaba kyrpang ia u

Rangbah B. L. Swer ba, nalor ka jingkyntu bad ka jingpynsblur ban pynmih ia kane ka kitab u la da ai syndon bad ki ktien kyn- pham halor kine ki jingpyrshang, Shuwa ban pynkut ii Nongthoh u pynpaw ruh ka jingsngew- nguh ia i Mr. Rockbornwel Soanes, Editor ka Kotkhubor ‘Ka Rngi’ bad i Mr. J. Kharmih, Editor ‘Ka Pansara’ kiba la iarap lem ban pynphriang ia kine kijingthoh lyngba ka kotkhubor jong ki. la ki jingkynthoh kiba la ai, la shon lang ha kane ka kitab. Shuwa ban poi sha ba pynkut, u Nongthoh u pynpaw ka jingsngewnguh ia U Blei U Trai Nongthaw-Nongbuh, Uba, u ngeit, khlem ka jingiarap jong U, um lah ban leh ei-ei ruh em. U pynpaw ruh ka jingsngewnguh na ka bynta ka jingkyrshan bor baroh kaba u ioh na la Rympei. Haba pyrkhat ia ka ngit-lngit bah kaba sah, bad ia ine i jing- pyrshang iba long tang kum i ‘phngit ne i thngit’ la sngewdei ban jer kyllum ia kine ki jingthoh ba ki long shisha tang ki ‘katto-katne shaphang ki katto-katneV VI Shikyntien, kum ka ktien-ai-khublei, ym lah khlem da pyn- paw kyllum ia la ka jingsngewnguh kaba ym lah ong shuh ryngkat bad la ka jingsngewkit-ram ia baroh ki LoDgshuwa-Manshuwa na kiba la ioh lad ban kylli ban pyrthew, ban lum ban lang ia ki phngit'jingtip kiba la klum hapoh kane ka thup, bad ruh L ban sa paw pyrthei lyngba ki thup ki ban dang mih hadien. Don

bun napdeng jong ki (ki Longshuwa-Manshuwa), kiba ym nang thoh nang pule, hynrei don pat ruh kiba la ioh shongskul. La pruid kyrkieh ia kine ki jingthoh tang kat ba kin ym jah noh, kyrmen ba yn sa nang kham pynbha irat na ka por sha ka por. La pyrshang ban thoh sriem kumba tyllun ka por ha ka shisngi — kata ban sdang naduh dang riew u syiar-nyngkong, suki-pa-suki baroh shisngi bad lyngba ka por sepsngi haduh ban da poi sha ka syn-nia, pynban hateng-hateng ka jingmut ne ka khmat ne ka dohnud briew, ki i kumba lada dum than ka pyn- ngiew bad lada shai than ruh ka pynsniew. Kaba biang hi ka del tang kaba shu pdcng bad kaba adkar. Kumba la thoh shakbmat, ka jingim ka dei ka Jingpyrshang. To ngin ia pyrshang ban nang laid shaphrang kaiba lah bor, katba shem lad bad katba shah por. RNGI TREP, RNGT JYNRIEW, WILLSON R. LAITFLANG, NONGTHYMMAI, Nongthoh. SHILLONG. Dated the 11th. Hynrei haba ianujor ia ka bad kiwei pat ki jait ktien ki riewshai ka pyrthei>

kam long satia ka ktien kaba riewspah. Te ban pynriewspah ia ka donkam ban pynrung ha ka thoh ka tar khasi ia ki ktien bad ki kyntien nongkyndong kiba don sawdong ka ri bad kumjuh ruh ia kiwei-kiwei ki jait ktien jong kiwei pat Ki jait bynriew kiba ngi sngew donkam ; bad hangne sngewkmen shibun ban lathuh ba 1 Bah Willson R. Laitflang, I la Teh ia kaba dei, da kaba sei madan syndon ia ki ha ka article jong I *Ki syllok ktien bad ki kyntien’ ba la shon ha kane ka Ishu. Ngi kyrmen ba kiwei-kiwei ruh kin nang iamih ban iabud lem ia ka lyoti ba I )a maitidiang’’. VII LA MAIT lA KA PHANG THYMMAI La slem ngi la iohi ia ka kyrtcng U Rangbah W. R. Laitflang (Uba ngi ju khot ieit khct jan — i Bah Wil) la ha ka makasin Ka Rngi ne ha Ka Pansara ha kaba la pynmih ia ki jingthoh ba la ai kyrteng “Katto katne shaphang ki katto katne”. Kum u briew uba ieit ia la ka ktien, ka kolshor bad litereshor jong ka, bad uba dang thrang bad kwah tip shuh shuh, ngani lah ban shu kbiini la ka shyntur khlcm iaroh ha kiwei bad ha une u nongthoh kumjuh. Ha la marwci nga la ju pyrkhat balei i Bah wil im pyn- mih pyrthci noh la kine ki jingthoh ha ka dur ka kot na ka bynta ka jingmyntoi kiwei bad lehse ban kham pynsuk ia ki research scholars. Ngi sngewbha shibun eh ba i Bah Wil myiita i la kloi ban shon la kane ka thup bad ban sam paidbah lem ia ki jingtip ba i la lum lyngba ka jingtrei shitom jong i lyngba ki laiphew sawphew sncm ei ei.

Nga hi shimct ngam sngewnud ban kren kynthoh ei-ei halor kane ka Thup kaba kum ka par hah ia kito baroh kibaieit ia Jaka ktien ka thylliej ba kan roi kan par kau san kan heh na ka por sha ka por. Nga ong ‘par bah’ namar hangne ngin shem lehse ja kiba ngi la tip niuina hynrei pat shi smam ryngkap ia kiba bun ki bym pal shym la latip. Ha nga hi nga shem ba don bun ki kynticn ba ngi ju lakren lapyndonkam man ka sngi hynrei haba shah kylli pyrthew ngi dum buit jlang ban batai namar ngim tip ki wan na ei ne mih na ei ha ka jinglong tynrai jong ki. I Bah Wil, kum u briew uba ieit bad niewkor ia la ka ktien, i la pyr- shang ban jubab ei ei katba don la i bor halor ka jingpyrta u Myllung Soso Tham mynnor. “Jingshai ngi wad sawdong pyrthei, Jingshai Ka Ri ngim tip ei ei”. Don bun jait ki jingieit-ri kiba uno uno ne kano kano ki lah ban pynpaw. Kawei na kita kaba nga ngeit ka long halor kane ka jingong ba ka “Jaitbynriew ka ira haba ka ktien ka im"’, kaba long ka jingsawa kyrtoh ha ki tyndong shkor jong nga la slcm mynta. Ngam artatien ba kane ka jingsngew ka long kumjuh bad i Bah Wil. Haba phai biang sha kane ka Thup kaba yin pat ju don koit ha ka thoh ka tar Khasi, nga tip shai ka long kaba nyngkong duh ka ban noh synniang sha kata ka jylli pule kaba ki khot Ka linguistics^ khamtamhaki tnat-pule jong ka kaba ki khot ka morphology bad etymology nalor kiwei kiwei pat ki shat-jingtip

kiba iadei bad ka rukom-im, rukom-trei bad saift-pyrkhat pyrdaih U Hynfiiewtrep shityllup ka Ri. Nga da ngeit skhem ba une U Rangbah un ym kut noh tang katne namar nga sngewthuh ba ki symboh-pyrkhat kiba la luni thup ha u thiar u sup jong u ki long kiba kyrhai kiba nga kyrmen un sa sam lem ha ngi baroh ha kawei pal ka Thup hadicn kanc kaba u la pynmih pyrthei mynta. Khatduh, kumba nga ju kyntu ia ki para nongthoh bad kunijuh ialade ha ka jingiadei bad ka thoh ka tar, nga ju ong long ki bym riej bad “Pyneh la ka Rngiew”. Kata ka long ruh bad phi Bah Wil. Na kata ka daw ki tymmen Khasi ki kynnoh ne jer ‘thynroit’ ia kawei na ki Jynnong-khlur, kaba pyni ia ka jingialang bun tylli ki khlur shi jaka. Maw-prem : Ka jingmut jong ka kticn prem ka kham thew ia ka jingialang bun kiei-kiei shi jaka tangba dang lah ne dang suk ban hiew bad bunsien ka kham thew ia kiei-kiei kiba kham hch. Prim pat ka mut kumjuh hi tangba ka kham thew ia kiba kham rit. Prip pat ka thew ia kiba la bun lajan bym lah shuh ban niew, bad prain bunsien ka thew ia kiba ym Jah shuh ban niew thikna. Nangta, ki sa kynnoh pynshoh-tar, prem-rem-rem, prim-rim-rim, prip-rip-rip bad prain-rain-rain. Ka prip rip-rip ka ia sriem jingmut bad ka prai-rai-rai. Ka ktien Trem* ki pyndonkam ruh kum ha kaba ong prem-mict, prem-shai, prem- tlang, prem-lyuir, prem-dum, ha ka jingmut ba kaei-kaei ka dang shu sdang. 6 KI MAW MON SING NE MAW MON SHUT Ka kyrteng tynrai jong unc u khlawait ka long u Mon Sing.

Don kiba ong ba u dei na ka jaid Shanglong. Hynrei na ka daw ka jingkhlain bad bor met jong u haduh ba la palat briew, la don ki shipai dkhar kiba sin ia u, u Mon Bhut, kaba mut ba ka bor jong u ka long kum ka bor ksuid. Ka kyrteng jong unc u nong- iapom, ka long ka jingtriem, bad ka biang ban pynkhynnuih bad pynkyiuh ia kiba bun ki nongshun haba ialeh thma ha ka por jong u. Katba lah ban tip pateng, une u Mon Sing um shym da heh briew eh. Ha ka rynieng ryniot, ka met ka phad, u long sriem hi kumba long ki para rangbah Khadsawphra. Tang ha ka jingkhia, te la ong, u iaryngkat bad arbriew kiba katjuh ka met ka phad bad ka rynieng kum ma u. Ka daw ka long ba ka met jong u ka tylli da ki dohksah bad ki shyieng-met ruh kiba heh bha. Shiwat ki shipai kiba ap kdong ki la ioh pduh klep ia u da ka suloi na shadien ha lew Langstieh-rim. La iathuh ba ki la pduh tyngeh da ka suloi na phang khlieh, hynrei um man kyllon satia bad ong (kiba iohi da la ki khmat) ba u la pyniap kylla ia kita ki nongpduh. Haduh kine ki sngi, ki dang don artylli ki Mawlong halor u lum kynthong, hajan ka Bir ba Mawpiah kiba ia pajih antad kumba 100-200 pruh uwei na uwei pat. Dei halor kine ki maw ba u Mon Bhut, u ju kilan met kilan phad ban pynkhlain ia lade, bad u ju ialehkai khlain da kaba rynsied halor jong kine ki maw. Na kane ka daw, sa tip ia kine ki mawlong kum ki maw Mon Sing ne Maw Monbhut, haduh kine ki sngi. Lah ban iohi ia ki- ne ki maw na ka surok kali na Nongkhlaw sha Patharkhmah.

Katkum ki nongthoh Phareng, ka bynta kaba kut ka jingim jong une u khlawait ha ka iapom kai-khlaw ne u kynja General ha ka Guerilla Warfare ka long ka bym sawa sngewiynnad : te kum- ta ka donkam ban iawad-iathud, iatih iakhlong ban lap ia ka jingshisha katba dang lah ei ban lap syrwet. Ka don kawei ka jingrwai (poem) kaba la tip pateng kum “Ka Jingrwai Ka Tnga U Mon”, ia kaba la ngeit ba la rwai nyng- kong eh da ka tnga u Mon Bhut ha ka por ba u tnga jong ka u dang leit ialeh thma. la kane ka jingrwai la rwai pateng da ka Jin Mahadei, ka tnga u Syiem Kine Sing jong ka Nongkhlaw. Kane ka Jin ka dei na Nongrmai na ka jaid Mawnai Jarain ne Mawnai- ain, kumba ki ju kynnoh lyngkot. Ia kane ka jingrwai ka tnga u Mon la pynmih teng ha ka Pansara bad la kylla ruh sha ka ktien Phareng bad shon ha ka Souvenir U Tirot Sing ba la pynmih da ka Khasi Cultural Society, Shillong ha ka snem 1984. U nong- thoh u la kynthoh ruh ba lehse ka lah ban long ka Poem kaba 7 nyngkong eh ba la thaw da ki Khasi, kata shuwa vvat ia ka jing- rwai ba thaw u Lar Sing Khongwir. La ngeit ba la rwai ia ka da ka tnga u Mon Bhut hapdeng ki sncm 1829-1833, kata shuwa ban wan u Sahep Thomas Jones bad ruh shuwa ia I Farad Rabon Sing Kharsuka. Ka Kor Ngon : Ka don kawei ka jaka ha kyntoit Maw-Koh Diang ha Nongrmai hapoh ka Hima Khadsawphra kaba ki tip kum Kor-Ngon. Don ruh kiba khot ia kata ka jaka ka Pyndeng-

Kongor. Ka ktien Pyndeng ne Pynden ka kham thew eh ia ka jaka kaba long madan, long pynthor, long thad. Ngon pat ka mut ba-i-sih i-sait-met, ba-i-bein. Kane ka Kor Ngon ka don ka lynter, antad, 1 50 phut la 50 phut ka pynkiang. Kham ha pajih pat don sa iwei i lum kyn- thong bad don ruh ka kynja kynton jyntep ha kaba la ngeit ba la tep hangta ia ka kpieng ka ksah ne ka spah ka phew jong uta u nongkhaii bah hyndai, uba kyrteng u Ngon. U lah ban dei na ka jait Nongsiej ne Jyrwa Nongsiej. Ki ju tip ia u kum u Ngon Kongor, namar ki ong la ring kongor teng ia u. Don pat kiba khana ba u la siew noh sha u Syiem shi-stieh-tyngka namar ba uni treh ban long kongor, Ki patcng jong une u Ngon Kongor, ki la thmu shiwat ban leit tih noh ia ka kpieng ka ksah ne ka spah ka phew, hynrei u Syiem Kine Sing u mana ia ki bad u ong, kam bha ban leit tih pat ia ka spah ka phew kaba la sah slem sha lum sha wah, namar ka lah ban shong ksuid shong khrei. U Syiem Kine Sing ka Hima Khadsawphra u long uba riam bha riam miat sriem ia u Syiem Hajon Manik jong ka Hima Soh- ra. Kiba la iohi ki ong ba u boh da ka khor, u spong da ka khor bad u deng u paila. Uwei pat u Syiem Khadsawphra, U Syiem Bidor, u long uba riam bha bad uba smat ban deng bad u paila uba heh, U ju riam kumne haba u wan sha sor Laban. Li- ne u Syiem u la iadon lang ha ka por ba iathoh-kurim I Bah Tho- mas Bareh ha ka snem 1938. Ka long kabamyntoi ban tip ba ki dkhar ki leh burom shibun ia ki syiem Khasi. Haduh ka por u

Syiem Bidor, ki dkhar ki pynshong ia u Syiem halor u hati haba u Syiem u leit peit leit i ia la ka it ka hima sha ri thor Assam. Ka Shnong Nongkhlaw : Kane ka shnong ka long kaba sa- wang bha, bad na kawei ka dong jong ka, lah ban shynna shaduh ki Lum Mangkashang bad ka Them jong ka Ri Thor Bramaputra. Ka long ka shnong kaba bit bha ban shna kut namar ka kynjang kumba 2 hajar phut na ka them kaba syndah jong ka shaphang ri thor. Ki tymmen ki khana, ba ka thain Khadsawphra ka donnam bha ha ka Hang jong ka jingsaifi nar bad pynmih ia ki kamar kiba tbit bha ban shna wait shna sum. Dei rub ha kine ki thain ba ki H Khasi ki la pynliem bun ki shipai ha ka thma Nongkhlaw kyn- thup ia u Lieutenant Burlton bad u Beddingfield ha ka jingiakhun ha ka snem 1829. Don ruh ka khana kaba jlan bad sngewtynnad kaba ia snoh bad ka jingiapoikha hapdeng U Jidor Syiem Nong- khlaw bad ka Tulamai kaba na ki Syiem Mylliem ia kaba yn sa thoh bniah hadien. U Lum lai khoh madot : Hyndai ki tymmen ki don la ki rukom kumno ban pynsah nam-sah kyrteng lada ia ki bricw ne ki jingjia kiba pher. Ka jingeh ka long ba kiba bun na kine ki kyr- teng la shu tip hi satang ia ka kyiteng, hynrei ym lah tip ia ka daw balei ba la jer ia ki kumta. Ki tymmen ki batai ia ka jing- shim por jong kawei ka thma ba ka long haduh ban da lut lai khoh u duma dih (kata u duma ba dih ki nongialeh thma kiba shong kut halor uta u lum). Na kata ka daw^ ki sa jer kyrteng

kumta ia utci u lum, U LUM-LAI-KHOH-MADOT. U Lum lai prah Lmein : Kawei pat ka thma ka long ba kaba ki Khasi ki sloit kawei-kawei ka bniat (kaba ki ong ha ka ktien shnong ka “Lmein”) na man uwei uwei u shipai Dkharuba ki ioh pyniap. Ynda la wai ka thma bad lum lang ia ki bniat- baroh dap lai prah kynton. Kumta sa ioh kynnoh, “U LUM LAI PRAH LMEIN”. Kane ka jaka ka don hajan Ri Khen ha Masar kaba hap hyndai hapoh ka Hima Myriaw. Ki Ain bad Ki Adong : Katba lah ban tip, ki Khasi ki bud pyrkhing bha ia ki aifi bad ki adong shnong na ka bynta ka bit- lang bad ka bha-lang jong u shnong u thaw. Niar eh ban don u ban tam-sneng ne pynlah ia kaba ki ia rai lang. Dei na kanc ka daw ba ha ki juk kiba kham ha shuwa la ju pyndonkam kynrei ia ka ktien, “Jong-shnong” kum “^Shoh-Jong-shnong” (kabamut shoh doh ne shoh dohkha), ‘beh-jong-shnong’ (kabamut banbeh mrad da ka shnong), shna jong-shnong, khang shnong, ap-shnong, ieng-da-ka-shnong, khyrdop shnong, ka um tong shnong, ka ma- dan shnong, ka skul shnong, ka khlaw shnong (lada ka khlaw kyntang ne khlaw adong) bad kiwei-kiwei. Shisien ong, la Jan ha bun bah kiei-kiei, ki kham sngewbha ban ieng nongrim ne ban ta- lywiar ia ka pyrkhat pyrdain ha ka nongrim jong ka shnong, wat ban pynithuh ialade, bun ki kham sngewbha hi ban ong. Ngadei u Nong kaba mut ban kdew iaka shnong. Kane kam ia snoh pat bad ka ktien ‘Nong’ kaba u briew u kdew ia ka kam ne ka jingtrei kaba u trei ne kaba im bainong ne sbai-nong, kum Nong-

trei, Nongkhaii, Nong-bylla, Nongkfiia bad kumta ter-ter. Hapdeng kiba bun syrtap ki aifi bad ki adong shnong, kawei kaba ki Khasi ki bud pyrkhing bha, khamtam eh ha ki por kiba mynshuwa ka long ki adong kiba ia snoh bad ka rep ka riang. 9 Kim ju pynhap pynnoh symbai, bet ne ot Jait tang ha ka sngi, ka por, ka la, ba la da buh kyrpang bad pynbna ruh da ki briew kiba la pynkhi m-ti ban pyndep ia kata ka kamrara. Nangnc ki Khasi t :i khem ia ka jingkylla ki por badki aiom. kfcn kyllum da I aba mg, “Ba ka maw, ka dieng, ka sim, ka doh, ki dang krca bricvv'”. Ha kiwei pat ki ktien, kaba mut, ba lia uba shernphang, lah ban iakrei ia sngewthuh wat bad ki maw ki die g, ki sim ki d di, ki nirad ki mreng, syricm kumba ia kren nc ia sngewthuh hi para-lriew. Dei kineKi jait jingstad kiba dang dv.akam baa wad ba i thud bniaa lyngba ki por. Kine ki Licng Shoh-kha (kiba ha ka jingshisha ki dci ki symbai han) ki ju her ryntih bad her don dur ba da ithiang hi ban peit ia ki haba ki her. Ka don kawei pat ka jait khlieng kaba bam ia kine ki Lieng Shoh-kha, badia kata pat ki tymmen ki sin ka Lieng-sngi. Haduh mynta-mynne dang lah ban iohi ia kine ki Lieng-shoh-kha ba ki her khamtam sha ki thain Langrin. Ki Maw-Iaw-Iang : Ki don ki mawbynna ha shnong Mawblei ba ki tip kum ki Maw-Iaw-Iang, Ki tymmen ki khana ba ha ka por ba thung ia u Mawbynna uba jrong eh, kim man lah satia ban pynskhem. Ynda la knia, ka jingkfiia ka pan da u Lang- long-Khlieh. Ynda kim banse shuh, ki la wad da kawei ka mraw dkhar ; ki phah tarn aiu-re-aiu napoh ka thliew ba la pynkhreh ban thung ia uta u maw, bad hamar ba ka dang tam, ki la sher 10

kynsan da uta u maw bad u la neh den.^ Ki tymmcn ki khana ba ki ring ia ki mawbynna na Maw-Phan-Niew sha Mawblei, ki da ong haba kup ka nia te tang da u jyntang-pathaw ruh la lah hi ban ring, namar umaw u i kumbashu wan hi. Hynrei lada pher ka nia, hana u Maw u lah ban leit phai kylla sha la ramew. Ym lah satia ban ioh jingshai kaba thikna, ki mut aiu haba ong, “U Maw u leit phai sha ka Ramew”. Naduh hyndai, ki tyramen kham bunsien kim ong satia ba ka jingkhia ka pan da u briew ne ba ka kwah briew^ hynrei ki ju kham ong, U Lang Thoh Khlieh, ne U Lang long Khlieh. Kane ka long ka jingkhia kaba kor tarn kaba ki ngeit ba u briew u lah ban ai sha U Blei, bad shisicn ong, long kumba ong ba U Blei ruh um banse khlem da pdiang haba la ai da kaei-kaei kaba kor tarn (Supreme sacrifice). Ka Japieh : ka long syriem ia ka jakoid tangba ka kham heh. Ki ju tba da ka ding mynmied haba ki kem Japieh, namar kam nang ban phet haba thaba ka ding. Don kiba shet, don ruh kiba shu thang, ki suh kyndang da u narsuh. Ka Hynroh : Ka Hynroh pat ka long lam heh kpoh. Ka long thoh rcw bad soh-kbruh bad kaba sniew dur bha. Kumta sa ioh kynnoh ‘Bam Hynroh’, lada ia u Bnai ne ia ka Sngi. Ka kham mut eh, ba ki long sniew dur ne jngut ne dum rong ne ba la kah da ei-da ei syriem kumba da don kaei-re-kaei, kaba bam kaba shrut ia ki. Kane ka jingong ka lah ruh ban don jingiasnoh bad ki puriskam Khasi hyndai. Jakoid : Ka kham rit, ka kham p’uiig bad kham lam stem.

Don kiba bam bha ia ka doh jong ka khamtam eh ia ka doh Ibong. La don teng-teng ka juk ha kaba ki briew ki la ia bam jakoid palat kat haduh ba U Syiem Khyrim u hap ban da mana, namar ba ki la jan duh jait ki jakoid bad la sdang ktah ia ka rep ka riang. Ki tymraen ki ong ba ka jakoid ka iarap ban pyniap la ki khniang ki ksiah kiba long ki nongshun jong ka rep ka riang. Don u jait kynbat uba ki jakoid haba ki lait na ka shyntur u bseifi ki ju leit bam bad jyllud ia lade da uta u jait kynbai, bad ki nongai-dawai-Khasi pat ki pyndoiikam ban shna dawai puh breift da une u kynbat. Na kane ka daw ki sa jer ia u ‘U kynbat jakoid’ ne ‘bat jakoid’. KA NIAM — KA THOH KA PULE KUM KA TNAT Kum ka jailbynriew ngi long ki briew kiba smat bha ban pakhet ne pynlyngkot ktien, bad ia kane bunsien la leh da kiba bun rukom — ki lah ban long da kiba shu mait, shu pom ne shu sloit tang ia ki dak, bad na kane ka jinglch lane kane ka 11 jingpakhet ka pynkulmar ia kito ki nongwei ki bym pat nang bha ia ka ktien Khasi. Kum ban shu ai nuksa, — u ong (i) (Ngan leit sha Jowai da ka Bus State Transport, (ii) U pakhet pat — Ngan leit da ka state bus, (iii) U pakhet shuh-shuh — Ngan leit da ka state. (Ki nongpule kiba kwah ban tip bniah ki Jah ban shem ha ka Shlem Ktien kaba la mih ha Ka Pansara, sien shon December, 1981). Na kitei ki daw ngi hap ban da pcit bniah ia ki ktien — lada

ki wan naphrang ne nadien, namar, dei na kine ki ktien-batai kiba iarap ban pynshai bad pynsngcwthuh ia ki jingiapher jong ki jingmut, kum kiaw bad kiaw-kurim. Lada shim pat tang ia ka ktien kiba la shah pakhet ne shah sloit, ka long shisha kaba eh ban sngewthuh, kum ka nuksa — haba ngi ong ‘lang' tip dei kaba na u blang ne u phlang ne u sohphlang bad kiwei-kiwei ; kumjuh ruh lada ngi ong ‘lieng’ hato ki sloit na u khlieng ne u theng ne nawei pat. Kawei kaba ngi ju shem ka long ba ynda haba la mlien bha ban pyndonkam tang da ka ktien lyngkot ne ktien pakhet hateng-hateng ngi thap klet noh lada ym ong eh kat haduh ba ym tip shuh ia ka tynrai, kum ka nuksa ; — kaba ngi ong “ka rong” ha ka jingmut kaba kyrpang, ban thew ia kaei- kaei kaba tang na sla ha kaba paw shabar (nalor kiwei-kiwei pat ki jingmut kiba kane ka ktien ka lah ban kit) ngi lah ban klet ba kane ka ktien ide ka wan na ka ktien “shynrong-shyn-taw” bad kumta hateng-hateng ngi ong ka ‘rong-ka-taw’ ia kiei-kiei ki kam kiba iasnoh eh ha kaba pynpaw pyrthei ne pynpaw shabar ba ki briew kin tip bad iohi. Kaiba lah ban tip, ki tymmcn ki ju ong ‘ksiew’ ia kiba shi-pa-teng na ki khun ; ‘ksiew-tun’ ne ksiew ar-pateng ; ‘ksiew- jap’ ne ksiew lai-pa-teng. La leh ia kane khnang ban pyniapher la kawei ka paieng bad kawei pat ka patcng. Hynrei, imat, na ka bynta ban nang pynjem shuh-shuh ban sngewthuh, ki tymmen ki shu ong noh — kito ki dei ki khun-miaw (ksiew ar pateng) ha ka jaka ban ong ksiew-tun : khun-khnai (ksiew-lai-pateng) ha

ka jaka ban ong ksiew-jap. Hynrei kane kam imat ban don jingmut ei-ei ruh ban long ha ka rukom kumba khein-bein ne pynhiar-kyrdan ia la ki khun ki ksiew. Ia kane ka rukom khein ksiew-tun ne ksiew-jap ki ju kham ong eh haba dei na ka liang ka khun kynthei. U nongthoh um poi tip saiia ban don shuh- shuh ki kyrteng palat ia ka lai pateng ksiew, namar ide ym ju kham don koit ki briew ban ioh ksiew palat ia ka lai pateng ksiew ha ka rta Jong ki. Don kiba kynnoh ‘khun jynrein’ ne ‘thapbawa’ ban mut ia ki ksiew palat lai pateng. Tip haduh katno ka shisha ym lah ban ong thikna, hynrei haiieng harum ki don ki jingsawa lyngba ki khanatang ba u l^un Khasi lane u khun u ksiew u Hynniewtrep u nang ban iam briew 12 da kaba pyrthuh na ki mrad kum ka sier, ka dngiera bad lehse kiwei-kiwei ruh. Haduh mynta-mynnc dang don ki lymmen kiba khana ba ka dngicm ka long kawei na ki mrad kiba ju jaw ummat shuwa ban dkut mynsiem. Kumba la kdew shakhmat, lehse kan iarap shibun kjda ngiii pcit bniah ia kine ki kyntien harum ryngkat bad ki kyntien batai ba pyniapher ia ki jingmut kawei na kawei pat ; — Syngken-kha bad Syngken-kurim, Khun-ruit^ Khun-ksjew, Khun, Khun-kha, Pyrsa-trai, Pyrsa-kur bad Pyrsa-kurim; Nia- kha, Ba-kha, Kmie-kha, Pa, Parad (ne Pa-kynrad), Pahep, Pa-men, Pa-pun, Pa-khynnah bad kiwei kiwei de, Shi-para-kur, Shi-para-kha, Para-shong-kha.

Kawei na ki rukom kyrkhu kyrdoh Jong ki tymmen Khasi ka Jving : — Ban roi ban pa. Kumta kane ka nongrim, lehse kan iarap ban shop ban weng ia kano-kano ka syrngiew jingmut kiba long tohmet ha ka jingpyrshang ki tymmen ban jer ia ki khun ki ksiew. Haba shu kren kyllum, ka ktien Khasi ka long ka jait ktien shi kynnoh, kum ban shu pynkynmaw ia kaba iatip lem, ngi ong U Biei, krlia, jer, shat, khein, em, ding, wah, lum, bam, dih, shong, Icit, wan, bad bun kiwei-kiwei pat kiba kum kita ler-ter . Ki don shisha hangne hangtai ki ktien kiba palat ia ka shikynnoh, hynrei lada bishar bniah yn lap ba wat napdeng jong kiba kum kita ruh, bun hi pat kiba dang iah ban pharia, bad kito kiba ym lah ban pharia shuh ruh, ki don hi la ka daw kaba kyrpang balei ba ki ong kumta. U Khasi u long uba la don la ka niam bad ka jingshai naduh ki sngi u Hynfiiewtrep Hynniewskum. U la nang kumno ban rep ban riang ban sain pyrthei, ban seng hima haduh u pud ba ki ri kiba lashai ruh kim lah khlem da pyrto ia ka jingstad bad ka buit synshar jong u. U la lah ruh ban saiil ban tiah biang-pa- biang ia ka rukom kheifl-kur kheifi-kha, khein-jait, khein-kynja ha ka rukom kaba stad shibun bad u da jer kyrteng bin ia ki jait jingiakam bad jingiadei baroh la ha ka liang kur ne ka liang kba. Nalor nangta, u da lah ruh ban jer kyrteng bin-pa-bin ia ki jing- thaw baroh naduh sahitbneng haduh poh-ramew. U jer kyrteng lin ia baroh ki jingthaw jongkamariangkat kibau la shem naduh

shynrong khlieh haduh pohjat. U la jer ruh ia ki blei ki dken bad ki ksuid ki khrei. Hato sngew-shongnia hi ban ong pat, ba ka jaitbynriew kaba lashai katne ba kan ym don ktien wat tang ia ka ‘Niam’ ruh ? Ka Niam Khasi ka long kaba la rim, wat 13 lada ngi shim ba ka rim tang kat ki maw-bynna bad ki maw-niam kiba don kylleng kanc ka Ri Lum. Kumne ki ju leh haba ki ia shem haneng-harum, haba leit kai sha iing ki lok ki jor, haba poikha poiman, bad kumjuh ruh haba iap, Haba ki Khasi ki noh ‘wai kyntien’ haba iap briew kam mut satia ba ki iasong kwai

ban bam u men-iap, hynrei tang ban pynpaw ia ka dak ka jing- sngewjan ka jingsngcwieit bad ka jingsngewburom na ka bynta jong u. Kumta ruh haba ki ong ‘bam kwai ha dwar U Blei’ ka mut ba ki pynpaw ia ka jingsngewburom ia uta u briew uba ki ngeit ba U Blei Un pdiang sngewbha ia u katba kum ki kam hok ki kam donburom kiba u la kamai bad leh ha kane ka pyrthei. (La sot na ka jingkren u nongthoh halor ka phang ‘KA NIAM BAD KA THOH KA PULE’ kaba u la kren ha ka Seng Jingtip, Mawkhar, Shillong, 1968). Ka Ktien Sing : Ki tymmen Khasi ki don ka kynja jingniew- kor kaba kham pher ia u Sing napdeng ki laiphew rorad baroh. Kumta, tynda-tyndi, donjia krkiba sngewbha ban pynsyriem da kaba jer kyrteng ia la ki kbun ki kti da kane ka kyrteog ne ban 22 pyniasoh ia ka teng-teng na khmat ne nadien katba ki sngewiahap ne kumba ki ju ong, ‘katba soh ka kyrteng’. Kumta, ngi shem bun pateng ia ki briew, khamtam ia ki shynrang, ba la jer da kane ka kyrteng, kum Lur Sing, Kam Sing, Bor Sing, Suba Sing, Burom Sing, Sing Manik, Tirot Sing etc. U Lar Sing Khongwir (uta u rangbah Khasi uba nyngkong eh ban leit sha Bilat) u long uba la jer kyrteng ia u halor kane ka nongrim ha ka snem 1838. Ka ktien ‘LAR’ ka mut poi ; kumta Larsing ka mut ba u Sing u la poi ne la wan poi u Sing ha ka ling ka sem. Ki don pat ki kur ki jait kiba pynkapia kane ka kyrteng (kum ka title) ha la ki khun ki ksiew ban pynsah-nam sah-kynmaw

ia la ki kthaw-lang ne kpa-tymmen kiba don ia kane ka kyrteng. La ha kano-kauo ka nongrim, ki kyrteng ba ki tymmen ki jer, ki long kiba kit bad ka jingmut. U Khasi u don bun ki kyrteng : Ki nongwei khamtam ha ki pateng kiba la leit noh ki lyngngoh shibun ban shem ba u Khasi u don bun kyrteng. Nalor ka kyrteng ba la jer, ynda u la don khun, ki ong, u kpa kata-kata, ynda u la don ksiew pat ki ong, ukthaw (ne kparad) uta-uta, kumkanuksa, ia u Thule Laitphlang, ki ong, u kpa ka Hir Lakadong ne u kthaw u Bhaju. Na kane ka daw, don ki pud ha kaba la shitom ban tip ia ka kyrteng tynrai, namar wat ha ki bui ruh la thoh da kitei ki kyrteng pynbud kum u kpa ka Bari (uta u tymmen uba la iarap ia u Sahep Dr. John Roberts ban pynkylla Khasi ia ka Bible baroh kawci). Ka kyrteng jong u ka long u Ruton. Haba dei badei pat, ki kyrteng ki kylla haba ki briew ki leit kylla niam : Ha ka spah snem kaba la leit noh ne lehse wat kham hadien rub, ki don ki hud ha kaba la ai noh da ki kyrteng niam (thymmai) ha ka jaka ki kyrteng Khasi kumne : — Ka Phuhbamon — kylla sha Ka Tiewrah. Ka SiarbamoQ — kylla sha Ka Martha. Ka Lahbamon — kylla sha Ka Sarah. Tang ia u ne ka khun nyngkong la pynsah kumba la jer, namar ioh kulmar ynda khot u kpa uta-uta ne ka kmie kata-kata, kum ia u Donrai Diengdoh — kim shym la kylla kyrteng wat ynda u la long khristan ba u dei u khun nyngkong.

Khi-Lai-Nuid : Ki tymmen Khasi ki khana-pateng ba haba khi ia u shniuh khlieh, bunsien ki ju pyndonkam da ka tari-dab. Haba ki khi ia u shfiiuh, ka jingthmu kaba kongsan ka long ba ki khynoab kin shait kin khlain kin kbie kin san, kin eh ka rogiew ka rwiang, kumjuh ruh ba u shniuh un mer un bha. Ki ju leh kumne ia kiba dang khie dang san — ki ieb kbyndiat ba mar phang tyr- 23 wiang-khlich la u shynrang, bad hai eng lyrgthohdoh pat ia ka kynthei. la one ki ong u Aiuh-thong ne tliuh-blei ne niuh-trong. Hynrei ia uno ma u khynnah u batam sneng ne leh ia ki kam kiba i-sait-met, ia u kynja uta pat ki khi kham pher na ki para khyn- nah— kata ki ieh ki snuid ne ki khi-lai-nuid, kumta ba ka khlieh jong u hi ka iathuh ia ka jinglong jong u. Suki*suki, ki pyndon- kam da kane ka rukom ban khi wat ia u rangbah briew ruh, lada jia ba u lajeh ia ka kynja kam sniew ne ka sang ka ma, haduh u pud ba ki ia hiew ia uta kum u bym bit shuh ban ia im-lang sah- lang. Kana : kawei na ki rukom pyndonkam ia ka ktien Kuna ne Kuna-Kuni, kumba ki ju kynnoh ka long ban mut ia ka kynja *‘dong” jong kaei-kaei. Kumta haba ki rah ia ka kynja tabut ne tasia, ki da teh bad kdoh bha da ki ksai ne lyllai na baroh saw tylli ki kuna ne ki dong khnang ba kan skhem ha kata ka rukom ba kan ym kyllon na kaba lah shiliang. I'e, hadien-hadien, ia kine ki ksai ki shu ong lyngkot ki ksai-kun ne‘sai-kun’ ha kajaka sai-kuna. Nangne ki sa pynsyriem ia kaei-kaci kaba iskhem ka-

ba ibiang thew, ka bym isyier kaba ihap-dong idap-dong, kum kaba ishongkun bad ia kaei-kaei pat ka bym idon-nongrim ne iskhem ki ong ka long syricm kum ka tabut-khlem-sai-kun. Don ruh sa uwei pat u tyllai ba ki ju kham pyndonkam ha kaba teh ne pynskhem ia ka lieng ba kan neh ne ban ym phet haba ka sa- ngeh ha wah, uba ki khot u Sai-gun ne u sai-kun namar ki Khasi ki shitom ban kynnoh ia u *G\ Ada-Dak : Kawei na ka jingmut jong kine ki ktien katkum ka jingiathuh ki tymmen, ka long kajaka sangeh, kajaka sbong- thait, ka jaka bujli ia ‘ka Dak’ lane ka jaka kylliang kulai haba kit’dak. Hyndai, ki ju kit ia ka *Dak’ (Mail) da ki briew naduh Gauhati sha Laban (Shyllong). (Ki Phareng ki hikai ia ngi ban spel dak Shillong ia ka Shyllong). la kine ki briew kiba kit dak ki khot ki Dak lane ki Nongphet Dak (Dak Runners) : sngewmat ki nongphet dak na Gauhati sha Shillong ki iadon lai ne saw ngut. la ki jaka ba ki nongphet dak ki ia aiti-pateng ia ka ‘Dak’ ki khot ki Ada (Stage). Hadien pat ynda la kit dak nob da ki kulai, ki ju kylliang kulai ha kitei ki Ada. (Kane ka kyrteng Ada ka mih ha ka kotkhubor, ka Pyrla Jymmang 5, 1984 ha kaba la thoh kumnc : “ Ka pynlyngngoh ia ngi ban iohi ba ka Sorkar ka shah ban pynieng kali ha G. S. Road ha ka shnong kaba ki khot Ada harum Damsite”). Kumta ruh, ki tymmen hadien-hadien, ki ong, ada-pa-ada haba ki mut ban ong shi-thait-pa-shl thait, he ban Ieh ne trei ia kano-kano ka kam ym dei shisien trei, hynrei ban da sangeh artat pateng-pateng. Ki tymmen ki khana ba

ha ka por ba ka Sorkar Phareng ka !a mut ban pyhrung noh da ki kulai ban kit dak ha ka jaka ki briew, kita ki nongphet-dak (kiba dei ki Khasi) ki la ong ia ka Sorkar ba ki ruh ki lah ban poi 24 stet katba poi ki kulai. Ka Sorkar ka la pynbeit ban da pynlong da ka jingtynjuh. Ha kata ka sngi la ialum bun u paidbah ban jngoh kai ia kata ka kam. Ki Khasi ki march na ki lynti-khasi, katba ki kulai ki iaid na surok, bad kaba biria ka long ba ki iapoi mar ryngkat thik, bad briew bad kulai. Ki sahep ki la shaiong ngaifi kumno ban rai. Khadduh ki ong, ba ki briew ki la kham- thait ban ia ki kulai, ki sa buh noh da ki kulai. Kumta sa kit dak sa da ki kulai, la kumno-kumno, haduh ban da iaid pat sa ka motor-car lehse ha ki snem 1904-1905. Kawci kaba phylla ka long ban tip ba, kumei-re-kumei, ki tymmen, kat kiba la lah ban shem, kim ialap ia-riew satia shaphang kaba kit dak da ki ‘Be-nge’, lane ki ‘accelerated cart’. Ha ka surok na Gauhati sha Shillong, ka don ka jaka kaba ngi tip haduh mynta kum ka ‘Ada-dak’. Don ruh kawei pat ka jaka kaba hyndai ki ong ka ‘Number-Ten’, ia kaba ki tymmen Khasi ki kynnoh ka ‘Myrten’ namar ba kim lait kynnoh ‘number ten’. Ka-Ang : Ki tymmen ki batai ba ha ki katto-katne phew snem ba la leit noh, haba ki iasiat khnam ha ka Rong-biria, ki don ki jaka ha kaba ki da thew da u kynja thri na ka thong ha ka thong. Ia ka jaka ba ki nongsiat kin shong ruh ki da pruid jylli bad buh dak, ba ka khyndew ki khot ka ‘Ang’, bad u nongsiat

urn bit satia ban tab ne jam palat ia ka ‘Ang", katba lah ban sngewthuh, ka jingbuh ia ka Ang ka long ba ki nongiasiat, la ki shong hangno-hangno, ka jingjngai na ka jaka shong ka long katjuh thik na ka thong ne ka skum. Don ruh kiba pyndonkam la kane ka ktien ban mut ia u kynja lain ne ai-lain; tang haba ka mut ia u lain, ki ong ‘U Ang’ ha ka jaka ‘Ka Ang’. Ka Wah Ryndi ; Katba lah ban kynmaw naduh ki snem 1950 ei-ei, paidbah ki briew ki rwai ha ki jingrwai (Poetry), ki phawar bad ki kynnoh “Naduh Rilang haduh Kupli Baroh ka dei ka Ri jong ngi”. Hadien kitei ki snem la don tcng kiba ialap-iariew ba kaWah Ryndi ka pyniakhlad ia ki katto katne ki shnong kiba don ha ki thain Lyngngam ha Khasi bad ka Garo Hills. Katba lah ban iohi bad tip na ka jingleit jngoh ia katei ka thain Lyngngam ha ki snem 1960 ci-ei, ka Wah Ryndi ka long ka Wah kaba rit kaba ka kynjang ka long antad hapdeng 10 bad 12 phut bad don jaka-jaka baka kdan haduh kumba 20 phut. Ki trai shnong ki batai ba ka mih na shaphang Laogdongdai na kjat Lum Dubir bad ka leit hap ba ka Wah Kangsieh. Yin pat lah satia ban kem jingmut balei ba la jer kyrteng ia ka Ryndi ; ki Khar Garo pat ia kane ka juh ka Wah, ki kham tip ia ka kum ka 25 *Rongnga’. Don kiba batai ba, hana, la don teng u briew uba kyrteng u Rongnga uba la shah rong ha u bscift-um, bad naduh

nangta ki sa jcr ia ka Rongnga. Ki shnong kiba don harud ka Wah Ryndi : Nong-um-kap; Nong-mi-sei; Nong-kabur; Por-thyrnang; Nongrthaw; Jynru- Niangbrah; Rengshiang bad kiwei-kiwei, shapoh Garo pat ki shnong kiba harud ka Wah Ryndi ki long ka Rongchong; Neng- khram: Ronga-apal; Rong-gisim; Mongo-daso bad kiwei-kiwei. (Ki don bur tylli ki shnong kiba la ju hap tcng hyndai hapoh ka Hima Khasi, hynrei na kano-ma-kano ka daw hadien ki la hap noh hapoh Garo Hills. Ki tymmcn ki ong ba ha ka shnong Neng- khram kaba sha shiliang ka Wah Ryndi la ju shong mynwei da ki Jong u Bolsuram jaid Pashi, hynrei hadien pat sa thied noh ki Garo bad mynta ka hap hapoh Garo Hills. Ki nongpule kin sngewbha ban kynniaw ba kajingjer ha kijingrwaine phawar ia ki lum ki wah, ki jaka ki puta ka lah ban iahap ne ban ym iahap sbiak bad u pud u sam Jong kano-kano ka hima ne ka bri, namar bunsien ka kham thew eh tang ia ka phang ne ka thaih). — : 0 :— KA RUKOM TYNKAI MET-IAP U Aron, jaid Kliarbani uba la longSordar la bun phew snem ha Nong-um-kap, u khana ba haduh ki snem ba khie ka Thma Bah Pyrthei kaba Ar, ki briew ha kilo ki thaih ki ju tyngkai ia ka met-iap slem-slem, kata da ki bnai ne wat da ki snem ruh. Ki briew ki ap haduh ban da lah ban kynshew pisa khnang ban lah pynbiang ia baroh ki jingdawa ki jingdonkam kynthup ia ki jing- dah jingdang kiba donkam ban pynieit niam ha ka jingknia.

Ki ju buh ia ka met-iap ha ka iing ne ka sem ba lashna kyr- pang harud-nong bad katba lah, ki jied ha ka jaka ba ka lyerkan ym beh shaphang shnong. Kiba ha iing u men-iap ki ap ia ka met bad kirn sum kim slch katba ym pat lah ban pynkhuid bad thang ia ka. Lada jia ba iap noh u tnga, ka tnga jong u ka ap ia ka met bad lada ka palat ia kane, ki kur u nongiap ki khein ba ka long kumba klim bad ki lah ban daifi kuna. Hyndai ki bud pyrkhing bha ba lada jia ba jah wat tang i dkhot met iba rit, ong kum i shympriahktL ki kur u nongiap ki lah ban daih kuna. Don ki iing kiba thung maw kum ka dak ban pynsah nam ia la ki longshuwa. Katba ki riewtymmen ki lah ban kynmaw, kawei na ki jing- thang-briew kaba khadduh ba la pynieit niam ha katei ka rukom ka long kaba thang ia u ktbaw (kparad) u Kansing Borshukrei ha Nonghawei hadien ba la tyngkai ia ka met hynriew bnai. 26 Haba shu kren kyllum, ka rukom tyngkai-met-iap, idi^ ka long salonsar hapdeng u khun Khasi Khara, kata wat hapdeng kito ki bym bat shuh ia ka Niam Khasi. (Ki tymmen Khasi kiju kynnoh, “Ka jingiap kam ju thala^’). Ki daw kiba hham paw ki long ba ka jingpynleit-niam pyn- leit-rukom, lada ka long ha kano-kano ka dur, bunsien ka dawa bad ka iasnoh bad ka jinglut. Nalorkata, donkam ban pyntip ia ki kur ki kha bad ki lok ki jor ban pynkhuid ia ka met. Kawei pat ka long ka kynja jingngeit, ba don u kynja kyrwoh uba maian

hapdeng kiba im bad kiba iap, kumta kim ju leh thala ia ka met- iap. Ngi iatip ba hapdeng ki Syiem Sohra, ia ka met-iap la tyngkai bun snem namarbaka thang (cremation) k^ iaid ryngkat bad ka thung (coronation) bad kum ka nuksa, ia u Syiem Ram Sing uba la iap ha ka 23 laiong 1875, la thang haduh ka 5 bad 6 tarik Lber, 1908 da u Roba, u da shim ram Rs. 15,000.00 (khadsan hajar) na ka Sorkar bad u paid nong-on-thang u long kumba 10,000 ngut. Hapdeng ki Syiem Nongstion ruh ki ju tyngkai ia ka met-iap haduh ban da lah ban pynbiang ia ki jingdawa. Ki tymmen ki khana ba ia u Syiem Don ne Don Raja la tyngkai kumba 9 snem: ia u Mon Syiem 3 bnai bad ia u Byrson Syiem 2 bnai. Ha ki thain Nongstoin ruh ki thep hi ia ka met hapoh kn shyng-oid syriem kumba leh ha Sohra bad ki jiar ia ka pyut shapoh khyndew, tangba ki kham pyndonkam da u skop soh-riew na ka bynta ban set ia kaba pei. Ki tymmen kim shym batai eiei la ki pyndonkam ne em ia ka ngap bad u sohjew ha kaba tyngkai raet- lap, kumba leh sha ki thain Sohra. U Rthaw : Ha ki thain Lyngngam khap Garo ju jyllei bha u siej uba ki jer kyrteng u ‘Rthaw’ bad don bun ki jaka ba la tap khlaw da une u jaid siej. Ki Jaid Thien - Ki don kumba lai jaid ki thlen lum : u thlen ktieh uba thoh bthuh ; u thlen-ni ne thlen syiem uba thoh stem; u thlen-krem uba thoh-lieh thoh-iong. Ia ka khlein jong u thlen-

lum ki shna dawai» bad don kiba ngeit ba ka long dawai ruh ia kito kiba ngeit ba ki pang thlen. Kitei ki jaid thlen ki kham don kynrei sha ki thain Lyngngam. Ki Jaid Dieng : Haduh kumba 20-25 snem mynshuwa dang don bun ki dieng bah kiba sbi-piam,^ ar-piam star sha kine ki thain Lyngngam^ hynrei nadoh ba la lait kali la shitom ban iohi ia ki dieng-bab. 27 U Koh-Na-Hei : Ha kine ki thain Lyngngam, ki trai shnong Jci ialap ruh shaphang u jaid-ksuid uba tip kum u Koh-Na-Hei Uba ju paw ha ka dur kum u kulai. Unc u jaid ksuid, ki ong, lada u jliah ia uno-uno u briew, uta uba shah jliah u sah satang ka shyieng suda. Sohra : Ki don kiba batai ba kane ka shnong ka ioh ia la ka kyrteng na ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Soh-ra. Hynrei lyngba ka ji ^gthud bniah, ki lymmeii ki batai ba ka ktien ‘Ra’, bunsien ka thcw ia kaei-kaei ka bym-long bym-man, ka bym-sei-soh, ka- ba lyugki, kaba ym-Iarkam shuh bad kiba kum kita ki jingmut. Kumta, ka Sohra ka kham mut ia ka jaka kaba khlera-soh lane bym-sei-sob. Kane ka thain ka long kumta na ka jinglong ka ram-ew hi ba ka Jong ka kynja sa-tap mawsiang bad shong maw- ramsong bad ba la nang iarap ban pynlong syllen shuh-shuh ia ka da ka jingtrei ki bor ka mariang, kum uslap, u phria, kasngi, ka Iyer bad kiwei-kiwei. Lelise ki stad ram-ew ki lah ban ai jing- batai bniah shaphang ka jinglong ka ram-ew ha kane ka thain.

Ka ktien ‘Ra’ (nalor kiwei-kiwei pat ki jingmut ba ka kit), ka kit ia katei kajuh ka jingmut ha ka jingiasnoh bad ka ktien ‘Leng-ra’, ‘Nong-ra’, bad kiwei-kiwei kiba kum kita. Soh-ra-rim : Ki tymmen ki khana ba ka shnong Sohra ka ju long ha katei ka jaka naduh ki juk sbuwa ban wan poi ki Phareng. Ka don kawci ka jaka hajan ban leit sha Palong Ka Ber kaba kikhot Mawpun-Sobra-Rim, namar ki ong ba dei nang- ne ba ki iaid Jynti hyndai ban leit sha Snhra-rim. Ki tymmen ki ong ba ynda jop noh u Khadsawphra ia ka Sohra-rim ki Sohra ki la iakhun tyngeh hajan Riat Mawiew. Hangta ka don ka kha- rai shakhmat bad ka Riat Mawiew pat shadien, bad dei ynda la poi hangta ba u Khadsawphra u luin bad um nud tur shuL Ki tymmen ki iathuh ba hajan jong kane ka kharai u don uwei u mot uba ki tip kum u Mot-Ka-Iaw-Tira. Une u mot u don ha ka jaka kaba ki khot ka Maw-rin-rin, hajanjongka shnong Kyntur-sniang. U ieng ruh ha ka jaka kaba kham lum na kaba lah ban shynna ia ka Shnong Sohra kaba mynta. Ka-Rynsan-U-Buh : Katba lah ban tip, kane ka rynsan ka ioh ia la ka kyrteng na u Buh Singh Syiem, U Syiera Mawsmai uba ju leit shongkai bam Iyer ha kane ka jaka. Hadien ynda wan poi ki Sahep Ropeway, namar ba kim lait ban kynnoh Khasi Rynsan- U-Buh^ ki kynnoh pynban ‘Rang-Sna-Bo’. Nong-saw-lia : Ki tymmen ki ong ba kane ka shnong ka ioh ia la ka kyrteng namar ka jingdei sngi naduh dang step phyrngap. Ka sngi ka noh-kjat ba kane ka shnong bad ka dob ia ka naduh

ka por ba ki kjat-sngi ki dang lung bad dang sawlia. Ka jingmut 28 jong ka ktien ‘Sawlia’ ne ‘Saw-lia-lia’ ka long kaba saw malu- mala. Ka don ruh kawei ka phud hajan Pomsohmen kaba ki khot ka Um-Saw-Lia, Kham sharum jong ka Nongsawlia ka don ka ksaid kaba tip ia ka kum ka ksaid Noh-Sngi-Thiang. Ka Siat-Bakon : Ki tymmen ki khana ba ka Raj Shabong ka dei hyndai ka jaka jong ki Synteng bad u Bakon u dei u khlawait ki Synteng, uba ki ioh siat ki Shabong ha kane ka jaka. Ki tym- men ki iathuh ba ki syrwet jong kata ka thma hyndai ki dang don ha Ryngksai. Sait-Soh-Pen : La jcr kumta ia kane ka shnong namar shi- sien ha kawei ka por la jia ka nemsniew ha ka thain Sohra haduh u pud ba ki briew ki la donkam ban pynkdang ialade da u Sohpen. Ki don kiba kyllon iap ha ka por ba ki dang leit tih ia une u soh- pen bad sait ha ka wah duid kaba mih na shaphang ka dong ka- ba ynda wan ki Phareng ki pynlong ia kata kajakaka lum-jingtep Phareng. Ki sait ia ki soh halor jong ki mawsiang kiba don shi- lynter jong kane ka Phud-wah bad naduh kata ka por ki sa khot ka Sait-Soh-Pen. Nong-Wei : Ha ki thain Sohra ki ong ki ‘Nongwei’ ia ki khun soh-syiem kiba shabar ka Hima Sohra. Nong-Jan : Ka kham mut ia ki shnong kiba hajan ka Nong- bah ne ia ki briew kiba shong ha kita ki shnong synem kumba ki ong sha ki thain Jowai, ki Palat Shnong (kata ia ki briew kiba na

nongkyndong). Ra-Won : La bun snem mynshua, u la don u briew ha Jaiaw uba kyrteng u Rawon. Ki tymmen kim shym iathuh thikna nang- no une u wan ban shong shnong ha Jaiaw. U long u briew uba im da kaba khwai dohkha bad u ju leit ban pynlut ia ka miet sha ka Wah Umiam, U long u briew uba minot ha kata bad uba iaw ruh. Une, ki ong, u la pyrshang ruh ban wad jingstad da kaba leit sah sha wah bad ap ia ka por ba ka wah kan thiah, na- mar ka don ka jingngeit ba uno-uno uba ioh ban tong urn ha ka por ba ka wah ka ioh thiah, un ioh jingstad. Une u la iap ynda u la beh tymmen. Na ka kyrteng jong une u briew sa ioh kynnoh ‘Rawon’ ia uno uno u briew uba brai eh ha ka kam khwai doh- kha haduh mynta mynne. U Ra-Don : Une pat, ong ki tymmen, u long uba khlain palat ban bam mluh bad ia uno uno uba bam mluh palat ki sin ia u, U ‘Ra-don’ haduh mynta mynne. U Ra-Jon : la une pat, ki tymmen ki khana ba u long u ba- riam rynjain haduh katta-katta. Kumta ia uno-uno uba leh ryn- jain ki sin ne pyniasyriem kum u Rajon haduh mynta mynne. 29 Ka Surok-Tup : Ki lymmen ki iathuh ba ha ka por ka thma Synteng, ka Sorkar, ynda haba ka la shem ba jwat ban jop, kam banse ban pyrshang ban leit lam noh sa da ki tup na Laban (Shillong) sha Juwei (Jowai) lyngba ka surok ba la da shna kyr- pang. La leit rah ia kine ki tup ; hynrei shuwa ban ioh ban pyn-

donkam, ka lap bakut noh ka thma. Ia kata ka surok ki khot ia ka, ka Surok-tup. Kane ka surok ka iabud lang bad ka surok kulai tangba don pat ki bynta ba ka kdat lad. — : 0 :— Duitara : Ym lah ban ong thikna mynno ki Kbasi ki la sdang ban pyndonkam ia kane ka jingtem Duitara. Kum ban kyrshan ia kane ka jing- ong, ki tymmen ki ialap ruh ba ha ki por hyndai ki don ki briew kiba lem ia ka jingtem shi-sur kaba ki tip kum ka Ek-tara. Ia ki jingrwai kristan (Khasi Hymn) ha ka ktien Khasi la pyn- mih nyngkong eh da u Sahep Thomas Jones I ha ka snem 1846 bud sa ka kot jingrwai ‘Khasi Hymn Book’ ha ka 1853 da u Rev. William Lewis. Hadien la nang pynbun sha ka 75 tylli ki jing- rwai bad la pynmih ha ki snem 1860 bad 1866 da u Rev. Thomas Jones II. Nangta pat la pynmih sa kawei ka kot jingrwai kaba kham heh ha ka snem 1876 da u Rev. Hugh Roberts. Katba lah ban lum jingtip, ia ka rukom ban synran ia ki jingrwai ha iing- mane da ki kynja jingtem-jingput la sdang pyndonkam nyngkong eh ha Nongsawlia ha ki por khyndiat snem shua u Jumai Bah 1897 bad ka jingtem ba la pyndonkam dei ka folding organ ba wanrah bad tern u Missionary uba trei ha ki thain Shilot (Sylhet). la pyndonkam nyngkong eh da ka organ ha ka por I Miss A. W. Thomas, kata hapdeng ki snem 1897-1900. (La sot na ka Jing- kynthoh u Rangbah W. R. Ka Khlam : Ka khlam-ka-ngoh : Ki tymmen ki ong ka khlam ia kano kano ka jingpang kaba ktah ne sar ne pyniap bun ki briew — ka jingpang kaba la khie ha ka dur ka epidemic. Ki tymmen ki kynnoh ka khlam ka ngob, kata ba ka long kaei-kaei ka bym ju jia koit barabor, hynrei ka wan ‘Jngoh’ ne ‘Ngoh’ teng- teng. Kawei na ki jaid jingpang kaba ju khie ba kane ka dur ka long kata kaba ki khot ka pang-iap-them lane ka kynja cholera. La jer kyrteng kumta namar ki tymmen ki ong ba kham bunsien 30 ki briew ki ju kham ioh kem ia kane ka jingpang ha ki jaka them jaka thor ne Ri-Them. Ha ka khlam bah (lyngba ka pang-iap- them) kaba la khie ha Laban (Shillong) ha ka snem 1879, la ong ba la iap 144 ngut tang ha shnong Mawkhar. la kiba iap ki pyn- kit ia ki halor ki kali-bordi, ki tap da ki jain lieh bad leit rah sha rud-nong shaphang Mawlai. Katta ka trei ka jingshepticng ia ki briew ba hapdeng kata ka jinglyngwit, la don teng ba wat ia kiba ym pat dkut mynsiem ruh la rah bad pynkit lang ia ki bad kiba iap ; hynrei sngewbiria, ba wei ‘bym pat lut hi la u khaw’, don hi uba lait im tang kat ban sah iathuhkhana. Ki tymmen Khasi,

khamtam ha ki por kiba dang shitom ban ioh jingsumar kumba long ha ki por mynta, ki don ka jingpyrkhat tyndi-tynda ba ka long kaei-kaei kaba sngewsang-sot sngewngiew ruh ban iap da ka khlam, namar ba bunsien kim lah ne ym shah lynti satia ban da pynleit niam ne leh niam leh rukom thikna. Lehse, kane ka lah ban long kawci na ki daw ba sa mih ka kynja kticn-tim — ‘U ban da shoh ka khlam’ lane 'Ka ban da shoh ka ngoh’ ne haba kren shai, U khun ka pap ; U ban da shoh ka ngoh. Ha ka pyrkhat Khasi, niar eh ban don kaba kin sngewbuh-khoh ne niew palat nalor kata kaba haba u briew u iap, pynban ym lah satia ban pynleit niam. Ki tymmen, ia uno-uno uba iap khlem pynleit niam shuh tdot, ki ju ong — ‘Uta u la ryngkat ka mrad’. Ka Adong bad Bidong : Ki tymmen ki ju kham pyndonkam ia ka ktien ‘ADONG’ ban mut ba ka long ka jingmana ne ka jingkhang kaba dei lut ia baroh kiba hap ha kajuh ka jylli, lada ka shnong ka ilaka ne ka hima. Ka Bidong : La ju kham pyndonkam ban thew ia ka jing- mana tangba kaba ym da pyrkhing eh kat ka ‘ADONG’. Ka ktien ‘Adong’ ka kham iajan ka jingmut bad ka ktien Phareng ; PROHIBITION. ‘BIDONG’ ka kham iasyriem jingmut bad ka ktien RESTRICTION. — ; 0 :— Ki Tymmen Saw-Khmat : Ki don ki briew kiba kham mih phylla kiba don ka sap kaba kham pher ba ki lab ban iohi ia kiei- kiei palat ban ia kiba bun ki para-briew ki iohi. Kumban ai nu-

ksa, ki lah ban iohi ia kiei-kiei ki ban sajia, ki iohi ia ka jing- iaid-jingieng jong ki briew kiba ym don rta shuh, kata kiba Iajan iap. la ki kynja briew kiba kum kine, ki tymmen ki sin ia kL ‘KI TYMMEN SAW-KHMAT’. Kum ban shu ong ar-khmat ki iohi kumba ia iohi lem ki para briew baroh, bad ki don pat sa ar ki khmat kiba ngi ngim iohi, bad la ngeit ba da kita ki iohi ia kiei-kiei kumba la kdew ha neng. Haba shu kren kyllum, kine ki Tymmen Saw-Khmat ki don ka jingiasyriem bad kita kiba ki Phareng ki khot ki ‘Clairvoyant*. 31 ttyndai ki lathuhkhana ba don u ‘Luna Kulai’ uba hajan jong ka shnong Mawsmai kata hamar Nongthymmal ha Sohra. Ki ksuid ki ju pynlong Dorbar halor jong une u lum bad kine ki ^van sha Dorbar ki da shong halOr ki kulai. Kinc ki jaid briew kiba ong ki Tymmen Saw-Khmat, ki iohi ia kinc ki ksuid ba ki iashong kulai bad dei na kata ka daw ba ki sa jcr ia uta u lum, ‘Lum Kulai’ haduh mynta mynne. Pen Ryngkew : U don u jait Sohpen uba paw sha Ryngkew, kata uba la paw lypa ha khyndew, ia une u jait soh, ki ong u Soh-Pcn-Ryngkew ne lyngkot u Pen Ryngkew. Na kajinglong une u jaid Soh Pen, sa ioh ia ka rukom kren ne Phawar ‘Ka Shun ruh ym pat pei, la paw pen ryngkew’. Dungkura : Ki Khasi hyndai kim ju tip satia ia ka rukom iashoh iadat da kaba shu sah shu ia bok ne ‘boxing’ kumba ong ki Phareng. Ki Khasi ki tip tang ka ialympat, ki ia thab bad kiwei-kiwei kiba kum kiia. Dei ynda ki la iohi ia ki shipai doh- lieh kaba ki dkhar ki ong ki ‘Gora’ bad kiba ki Khasi ki kynnoh ‘Kura’ ba ki ia bok, ba ki Khasi ruh ki sa pyrthuh ban iashoh kumba ialeh ki shipai Kura, la kane ka rukom iashoh da kaba shu ia bok kaba wanrah ki Phareng, ki sa ong kaba sah-kura ne dung-kura kaba mut ban sah ne ban ia ‘box’ kumba ialeh ki shi- pai Gora, bad kham hadicn-hadien ki sa shu ong lyngkot noh ka- ba ‘kura’, Ha ki por ba ka sor ka dang don ha Sohra, ka don kawei ka madan kaba ki shipai Phareng ki pynshad shipai (Parade) ia ki shipai Gora ne Kura. Nangta sa ioh kynnoh ia kane ka madan kum KA MADAN PYNSHAD GORA, ne pynshad Kura haduh mynta mynne. Don pat ruh kiba ia kane kajuh ka madan pyn- shad Ghora ne Khora kata ban mut ka madan pynshad kulai na-

mar ki dkhar ia u kulai ki ong Ghora, hynrei imat ka jingbatai kaba kham tynrai ka long kumba, la batai sha khmat. Hadien- hadien, don ruh kiba kynnoh Pynshad-khurai. 32 Sah-Khir : Ki tymmen Khasi hyndai baba shun iano-iano ki ong ‘To kata, ngan shu sah khir nob’. Ym lab ban shemphang thikna kumno ki leh baba ki sah khir hynrei sngewmat ba ki shu sah pynskhem hapoh khyndew ne ha u kynja dieng ne hangno- hangno da u prek ne u kynja khir ryngkat bad ka kren ka khana. Tbung-Tasam : Ki tymmen bunsien eh ki pyndonkam ia ka klien ‘Tasam’ ban mut ia kaei-kaei kaba kynja nar ki da kynnoh ruh kum ‘KHRIAT TASAM’ kata kaba khriat la kum u nar, ‘EH TASAM* kata kaba eh la kum u nar, ‘BIEIT-TASAM’ kata ka long kaba shong jwat ne eh banpynpra nepynpaitia ka jingshong bieit kaba la shong-eh shong-jwat kum ka tasam. Haba ong pat ‘THUNG TASAM’ ka kham mut eh ka dak. Ki ju kham pyndonkam eh bad longne ieng kum ka sakhi ne kum ka dak ia kano kano ka kynja jingiasmai ne ia-tang ia-tait, ia kut-jingraut, pynwai-nia ne pynwai-jutang, ne kylla jingiadei ne kylla jutang noh na kaba ju leh ia kiei kiei sha kaba yn ym leh shuh bad kiba kum kita. Haba ki thung-tasam ki ju leh ne pyn- donkam ia ka wait-lymbuit kata ka mut ka wait ba tang ka nar su- da khlem sping ne jingsop eiei. la kane ka wait lymbuit (kata ia ka bynta badei ban leit hapoh ka sping) ki sieh ne sub hapoh khyndew. pyndonkam shuh. Don ki shnong kiba sieh ne thung ia ka wait- tasam ha ka dieng. Don ki shnong kiba kynnoh ‘Iheng’ ban mut thung. Kumta Mawthengkut ka mut Maw-thung-kut. Ka shnong Mawthengkut ka don ha West Khasi Hills Dis- trict. kjat na Jowai sha Laban (Shillong). Ym pat lah satia ban ioh jingshai ne jingbatai la kine arngut ki briew ki don jingiadei ei-ei ne em hapdeng jong ki, namar ka rukom ha ki por hyndai, kham- tam ha ka jingiaiaid lynti kaba jlan, bun bunsien ki briew ki ju da ia ap lok ban iaiaid ryngkat khamtam eh lada don ki kynthei- briew kiba na kano-ma-kano ka daw ki hap ban leit lynti wei briew ne sah marwei ne dkut noh ki nongleit lynti. Kumta ruh uta u rangbah sngewmat, u la shu poi iaiaid lynti ryngkat bad kata ka kynthei. Te, hamar ba ki tang shu lait ia ka shnong Po- mura ban kiew ia u riat Rynseng (ka bynta kaba bud lang bad ka surok kulai) bad hamar ba ki poi ha syng-it jong ka riat Maw- khlir, ha ka bynta kaba hh ban shynna ia ka wah Umngot, kata ka kynthei ka la lap kynsan ka jingthrang-um kaba jur haduh kat- ta-katta. Uta u rangbah haba u ia iohi ia kata, mar-mar u la shim da ka tyndong, lehse ka tyndong tympew bad phet kyrkieh arsut ia ka riat ban leit tong urn na wah Umngot. Ynda u la tong ia kata ka urn, u la kiew stet haduh katta-katta artet ia ka riat, bad ka la wan lap kynsan ka jingshitom ba ynda u la poi ha 34 kata ka jaka, u la lah ban kyrda tang kat ban shu ai ia ka um ha ka kti jong kata ka kynthei. Um shym lah shuh ban kren. Kata ka kynthei ruh ka lah tang kat ban shu shim ia kata ka um bad peit ia u bad uta u rangbah u la kyllon hangta. Hadien ba ka la dih ia ka um, bad ba ka la kham ioh bor, ka la pyrshang ban kren ia uta u rangbah hynrei ka shem ba u la lah dkut mynsiem.

Ha kane ka rukom bishar, ki ju song artylli ki jing- song kiba kumjiih-kunijuh. Ha kawei ka song ki buh da ka lyng- khot-ksiar, ha kawei pat da ka lyngkhot rupa. Ki thep ia kine ki jingsong baroh artylli hapoh u kynja khiew ne u kynja khra. Nangta ki s:i khot ia ki ar mamli ban iasei mar kawei ka song ha khmat u paidbah. Ka niamla kaba ioh ia ka song ksiar ka ksan bad kaba ioh ia ka song rupa ka rem. Kham mynhyndai eh, ki ong ba ki leh ia kane ka jingbisharha wah. Ki jujied ha ka jaka ba long ihwci ne long pung. la ki song artylli ki pda shapoh ka thwei bad ki bricw (kiba ki sin ki Ksih) ba la jied na baroh ar mamla ki sa ngam nc suh khlich bad sei mar kawei-kawei ka jing- song. kaba jop ka iarisa bad shad kumba shad-iasiat haduh ba ki kyn- thei kiba iashad kin da p;a sa ka pankhyllong, Leh-Sulan : Ha ki pateng kiba la leit nob, ki tymmen kham- tam ha ki thain Sohra hateng-hateng ki ju sin ne kynnoh ‘u la leh Sulan’ kata ban mut ia uno-uno u shynrang Khasi uba la leit-poi- kha bad ka Mem ne ka kynja dohlieh. Tc ynda u la iohi ia ka jingtbit ha kaia ka kam, u Sahep u la nangailad shuhshuh ba un pyntbit ha kata ka kam. Te ynda u la tbit bha, u la iawer ia u ban leit sha Bilat bad u Sulan ruh u la kohnguh. Ynda la poi ha Bilat, u Sulan da ka jingtrei minot bad jingtbit u la kiew kyrdan irat ha- duh ba la org ba la Ihung ia u kum uwci u ban iakitkhlieh ban shna ia kawei ka bynta jong ka jingkieng halor ka wah Thames ha Bilat. U Sulan u la ia-poi-kha bad kawei kasamla Bilat, bad ha ka por ba u thoh shithi sha la i kmie sha Sohra,^ u iathuh ba u la ioh iwei i khun kynthei, iba u jer i ‘Kyntiapmon\ Kane ka la jia katlo katne snem shuwa u Jumai-Bah 1897. KA KTIEN LAMPHRANG Ka jingthmu kaba kongsan ha kaba thoh ia kine ki jingthoh, ka long kurano ban kyntiew ia la ka ri bad ka jaitbynriew lyngba ka thoh ka pule. Naduh dang khynnah, la ju iohsngew ba kiba rangbah ki ialap-iariew shaphang ka jingkyrduh ki kot khasi. Kane ka jingpyrkhat ka la bat bad saiiidur ia ka jingmut naduh

kata ka por. Ynda la kham san, ka la iiang jur ka jingangnud ban thoh kot bad la kut jingmut ba dei ban leh ei-ei da lade ne ban bah wait lyngngun da lade. Ka jingpyrshang ban lum jingtip lyngba ki jingthoh ka long 1 a kam kaba jwat ; hynrei ka nang kham jwat shuh-shuh lada c’ei ban lum na ki briew kiba shu tipktien-tip pateng. Te khnang ban kham lashai lehse kan biang hi kat ban ring nuksa bad pyn- sriem malu-mala ba ka long kum u briew uba wad uba thud ban lap ia ka jaka badon ne shong mawpyrsut. Ynda u la lap, u hap pat ban tih ban shrot, ban khlong ban khlaw bad ban pyntuid- pyakit ia u mawpyrsut sha ki wah. Ynda u la kie ha ki wah, donkam pat banjiarban snaid pateng-pateng, ban phleng ban pynkhuid haduh ba un da pliah bad bit ban leit lam sha ka shlem- sain-nar. Shuwa ban saifi pat, donkam biang ban da mang ban da thew ban da dong ban sain-pynum ha ka ding barhein ka pa- jvva haduh ba un da man narliang-narwah. Na une u nar-liang narwah pat, ki kamar bad ki nongshoh-thaw ki sa sain-pynwan- dur ha ka shloin jong ki ban shna ia ki wait ki tari, ki mohkhiew bad kiwei kiwei de ki tiar kiba donkam. Ym dei pat ruh ban klet ba ha kum kane ka jaid jingtrei, ka hoit ka jaw, ka tait ka bret, ka khoh ka phler, ka phret ka phrong kaba byllai. Don ki jingeh kiba mih na ka daw ba ki jingtip ki shong saphret saphnang ha kylleng ka ri, kumta ba hap ban khar ban tarn ban lum shitom shidkhoi nangne shidkhot pat nangtai. Don pat ba ki jirgtip ki shong thup shong thiar kum ki shyieng bun

jait bun syrtap hapoh ka krem ka kroh, ka synrang ne ka thwei. Kumta ka la shim por slem-slem ban lah ban jied ban sot ban pyndait lang biang-pa-biang kat ban saindur ha kawei ka shruh ne ka shynrong (skeleton). Don ki jingtip kiba la shu ioh sriem kumba khalai-nusib ; ne long sriem kumba bthah ki tyramen, ba, ‘lada phi kwah ban ioh jingsiad, leit tong urn na wah ha ka por ne ka khyllipmat ba kawah ka iohthiah’. Don ki ricwtymmen kiba hadien slem-slem, ba la pyrsbang shitom, la lah shisha ban ioh iakynduh bad ia- shongkai bad ki. Hynrei kaba diaw ka long ba ka sien-shongkai kaba nyngkong (kaba teng-teng ka neh tang da ki minit) ka long artad ka sienshong-kai kaba khatduh. Haba jia kumne, poi haba jnang, namar shaei pat yn leit wad jingshai. Jar la katta ruh, ha ka jingbymbanse, la hap hi ban shu tare kulmar bad ban pyrshang ban batai tang katba lah ei ban shemphang. Kane ka pynkyn- II maw ia uta u tymmen Sohra uba ong, “Ynda la poi ha u pud uba nga ia lade ruh ngam lah sngewthuh shuh, to ieh nga mat shu tharai, nangta ngan sa batai^ bad phi lah ban ong ia nga, u ‘TharaUbataV ”, Kumba la kdew shakhmat, ki jingeh ha ka jinglum jingtip ki long kiba bun syrtap. Kawei na kita ka long ba don ki riew-tip- tymmen, hynrei ki lah pat ban batai tang ha ka ktien shnong. Nalor nangta, ki don ki ktien kiba ha ka ktien kot ki don kawei ka jingmut, katba ha ka ktien shnong pat ki kit da kawei ka jing-

mut. Ka jingkylla ha ki juk bad ki por ruh ka wallam ia ka jing- kylla ha ki briew. Ha ki juk kiba ia leit noh, paidbah kiei-kiei ki long sngur long synlar. Ki briew ruh dang bun kiba kren kumba ki mut bad ki mut ruh kumba ki kren. Hynrei katba nangiaid ki por bad katba ki briew ki nang kam ialade kum kiba la kham long riewshai (civilised) katta la nang duna ka jinglong- sngur ka jinglong-nylla. Katba nangiaid ki por nang jur ki musli-musla, nangrben ka tahrong-tahrup, haduh u pud ba mar shisien jngoh ne shisien madj la shitom ban ithuh ne sngewthuh kano kaba nylla bad kano pat kaba tang na sla. Ka plie lad bad ka khanglad ki iaiaid synrap kumba thain pi-ar. Ha bym pat lait surok kali, bun kiei-kiei ki sah nylla ki sah synlar, hynrei ban leit Jngoh ia ki ka long kaba shitom. Hyn- rei ynda la lait kali pat, ka leit ka wan ka la suk shibun tangba bun kiei-kiei ki la kylla dur bak-ly-bak, bad slem ka ktien, don napdeng Jong ki kiba la i kumba kin duh jait noh syndon. Nang lait surok, nang synlen ki khlaw, nang iwa ki lum, nang rwa u shyiap, nang duna u maw, nang jngut ki wah, nang iwkhong ka Iyer, nang rngad ki umtong-umdih. Don jaka-jaka kiba la Iwcl Iko hi pom sriem kumba hap bom ; don pat kiba la khynra pyn- kylla khongpong naduh tynrai sriem kumba khynniuh jumai. Ki skul ki la nang bun katba nang iaid ki sngi, bad don jaka-jaka ba ki la mih kumba jei ne ba ki la shu mih pathar kum ki tit. Ba ki jia ne ki wan ki jingkylla ym da don eh shibun ban da sngewphylla. Lajan baroh kiei-kiei ki kylla na ka por sha ka por, bad lehse kawei na ki bymjukylla ka long ka ain jong ki jing- kylla. Don kiba ong ba u dei na ka jaid Shanglong. Hynrei na ka daw ka jingkhlain bad bor met jong u haduh ba la palat briew, la don ki shipai dkhar kiba sin ia u, u Mon Bhut, kaba mut ba ka bor jong u ka long kum ka bor ksuid. Ka kyrteng jong unc u nong- iapom, ka long ka jingtriem, bad ka biang ban pynkhynnuih bad pynkyiuh ia kiba bun ki nongshun haba ialeh thma ha ka por jong u. Katba lah ban tip pateng, une u Mon Sing um shym da heh briew eh. Ha ka rynieng ryniot, ka met ka phad, u long sriem hi kumba long ki para rangbah Khadsawphra. Tang ha ka jingkhia, te la ong, u iaryngkat bad arbriew kiba katjuh ka met ka phad bad ka rynieng kum ma u. Ka daw ka long ba ka met jong u ka tylli da ki dohksah bad ki shyieng-met ruh kiba heh bha. Shiwat ki shipai kiba ap kdong ki la ioh pduh klep ia u da ka suloi na shadien ha lew Langstieh-rim. La iathuh ba ki la pduh tyngeh da ka suloi na phang khlieh, hynrei um man kyllon satia bad ong (kiba iohi da la ki khmat) ba u la pyniap kylla ia kita ki nongpduh. Haduh kine ki sngi, ki dang don artylli ki Mawlong halor u lum kynthong, hajan ka Bir ba Mawpiah kiba ia pajih antad kumba 100-200 pruh uwei na uwei pat. Dei halor kine ki maw ba u Mon Bhut, u ju kilan met kilan phad ban pynkhlain ia lade, bad u ju ialehkai khlain da kaba rynsied halor jong kine ki maw. Na kane ka daw, sa tip ia kine ki mawlong kum ki maw Mon Sing ne Maw Monbhut, haduh kine ki sngi. Lah ban iohi ia ki- ne ki maw na ka surok kali na Nongkhlaw sha Patharkhmah.

Katkum ki nongthoh Phareng, ka bynta kaba kut ka jingim jong une u khlawait ha ka iapom kai-khlaw ne u kynja General ha ka Guerilla Warfare ka long ka bym sawa sngewiynnad : te kum- ta ka donkam ban iawad-iathud, iatih iakhlong ban lap ia ka jingshisha katba dang lah ei ban lap syrwet. Ka don kawei ka jingrwai (poem) kaba la tip pateng kum “Ka Jingrwai Ka Tnga U Mon”, ia kaba la ngeit ba la rwai nyng- kong eh da ka tnga u Mon Bhut ha ka por ba u tnga jong ka u dang leit ialeh thma. la kane ka jingrwai la rwai pateng da ka Jin Mahadei, ka tnga u Syiem Kine Sing jong ka Nongkhlaw. Kane ka Jin ka dei na Nongrmai na ka jaid Mawnai Jarain ne Mawnai- ain, kumba ki ju kynnoh lyngkot. Ia kane ka jingrwai ka tnga u Mon la pynmih teng ha ka Pansara bad la kylla ruh sha ka ktien Phareng bad shon ha ka Souvenir U Tirot Sing ba la pynmih da ka Khasi Cultural Society, Shillong ha ka snem 1984. U nong- thoh u la kynthoh ruh ba lehse ka lah ban long ka Poem kaba 7 nyngkong eh ba la thaw da ki Khasi, kata shuwa vvat ia ka jing- rwai ba thaw u Lar Sing Khongwir. La ngeit ba la rwai ia ka da ka tnga u Mon Bhut hapdeng ki sncm 1829-1833, kata shuwa ban wan u Sahep Thomas Jones bad ruh shuwa ia I Farad Rabon Sing Kharsuka. Ka Kor Ngon : Ka don kawei ka jaka ha kyntoit Maw-Koh Diang ha Nongrmai hapoh ka Hima Khadsawphra kaba ki tip kum Kor-Ngon. Don ruh kiba khot ia kata ka jaka ka Pyndeng-

Kongor. Ka ktien Pyndeng ne Pynden ka kham thew eh ia ka jaka kaba long madan, long pynthor, long thad. Ngon pat ka mut ba-i-sih i-sait-met, ba-i-bein. Ki tymmen ki batai ia ka jing- shim por jong kawei ka thma ba ka long haduh ban da lut lai khoh u duma dih (kata u duma ba dih ki nongialeh thma kiba shong kut halor uta u lum). kumta ia utci u lum, U LUM-LAI-KHOH-MADOT. U Lum lai prah Lmein : Kawei pat ka thma ka long ba kaba ki Khasi ki sloit kawei-kawei ka bniat (kaba ki ong ha ka ktien shnong ka “Lmein”) na man uwei uwei u shipai Dkharuba ki ioh pyniap. Ynda la wai ka thma bad lum lang ia ki bniat- baroh dap lai prah kynton. Kumta sa ioh kynnoh, “U LUM LAI PRAH LMEIN”. Kane ka jaka ka don hajan Ri Khen ha Masar kaba hap hyndai hapoh ka Hima Myriaw.
