urn bit satia ban tab ne jam palat ia ka ‘Ang", katba lah ban sngewthuh, ka jingbuh ia ka Ang ka long ba ki nongiasiat, la ki shong hangno-hangno, ka jingjngai na ka jaka shong ka long katjuh thik na ka thong ne ka skum. Don ruh kiba pyndonkam la kane ka ktien ban mut ia u kynja lain ne ai-lain; tang haba ka mut ia u lain, ki ong ‘U Ang’ ha ka jaka ‘Ka Ang’. Ka Wah Ryndi ; Katba lah ban kynmaw naduh ki snem 1950 ei-ei, paidbah ki briew ki rwai ha ki jingrwai (Poetry), ki phawar bad ki kynnoh “Naduh Rilang haduh Kupli Baroh ka dei ka Ri jong ngi”. Hadien kitei ki snem la don tcng kiba ialap-iariew ba kaWah Ryndi ka pyniakhlad ia ki katto katne ki shnong kiba don ha ki thain Lyngngam ha Khasi bad ka Garo Hills. Katba lah ban iohi bad tip na ka jingleit jngoh ia katei ka thain Lyngngam ha ki snem 1960 ci-ei, ka Wah Ryndi ka long ka Wah kaba rit kaba ka kynjang ka long antad hapdeng 10 bad 12 phut bad don jaka-jaka baka kdan haduh kumba 20 phut. Ki trai shnong ki batai ba ka mih na shaphang Laogdongdai na kjat Lum Dubir bad ka leit hap ba ka Wah Kangsieh. Yin pat lah satia ban kem jingmut balei ba la jer kyrteng ia ka Ryndi ; ki Khar Garo pat ia kane ka juh ka Wah, ki kham tip ia ka kum ka 25 *Rongnga’. Don kiba batai ba, hana, la don teng u briew uba kyrteng u Rongnga uba la shah rong ha u bscift-um, bad naduh

nangta ki sa jcr ia ka Rongnga. Ki shnong kiba don harud ka Wah Ryndi : Nong-um-kap; Nong-mi-sei; Nong-kabur; Por-thyrnang; Nongrthaw; Jynru- Niangbrah; Rengshiang bad kiwei-kiwei, shapoh Garo pat ki shnong kiba harud ka Wah Ryndi ki long ka Rongchong; Neng- khram: Ronga-apal; Rong-gisim; Mongo-daso bad kiwei-kiwei. (Ki don bur tylli ki shnong kiba la ju hap tcng hyndai hapoh ka Hima Khasi, hynrei na kano-ma-kano ka daw hadien ki la hap noh hapoh Garo Hills. Ki tymmcn ki ong ba ha ka shnong Neng- khram kaba sha shiliang ka Wah Ryndi la ju shong mynwei da ki Jong u Bolsuram jaid Pashi, hynrei hadien pat sa thied noh ki Garo bad mynta ka hap hapoh Garo Hills. Ki nongpule kin sngewbha ban kynniaw ba kajingjer ha kijingrwaine phawar ia ki lum ki wah, ki jaka ki puta ka lah ban iahap ne ban ym iahap sbiak bad u pud u sam Jong kano-kano ka hima ne ka bri, namar bunsien ka kham thew eh tang ia ka phang ne ka thaih). — : 0 :— KA RUKOM TYNKAI MET-IAP U Aron, jaid Kliarbani uba la longSordar la bun phew snem ha Nong-um-kap, u khana ba haduh ki snem ba khie ka Thma Bah Pyrthei kaba Ar, ki briew ha kilo ki thaih ki ju tyngkai ia ka met-iap slem-slem, kata da ki bnai ne wat da ki snem ruh. Ki briew ki ap haduh ban da lah ban kynshew pisa khnang ban lah pynbiang ia baroh ki jingdawa ki jingdonkam kynthup ia ki jing- dah jingdang kiba donkam ban pynieit niam ha ka jingknia.

Ki ju buh ia ka met-iap ha ka iing ne ka sem ba lashna kyr- pang harud-nong bad katba lah, ki jied ha ka jaka ba ka lyerkan ym beh shaphang shnong. Kiba ha iing u men-iap ki ap ia ka met bad kirn sum kim slch katba ym pat lah ban pynkhuid bad thang ia ka. Lada jia ba iap noh u tnga, ka tnga jong u ka ap ia ka met bad lada ka palat ia kane, ki kur u nongiap ki khein ba ka long kumba klim bad ki lah ban daifi kuna. Hyndai ki bud pyrkhing bha ba lada jia ba jah wat tang i dkhot met iba rit, ong kum i shympriahktL ki kur u nongiap ki lah ban daih kuna. Don ki iing kiba thung maw kum ka dak ban pynsah nam ia la ki longshuwa. Katba ki riewtymmen ki lah ban kynmaw, kawei na ki jing- thang-briew kaba khadduh ba la pynieit niam ha katei ka rukom ka long kaba thang ia u ktbaw (kparad) u Kansing Borshukrei ha Nonghawei hadien ba la tyngkai ia ka met hynriew bnai. 26 Haba shu kren kyllum, ka rukom tyngkai-met-iap, idi^ ka long salonsar hapdeng u khun Khasi Khara, kata wat hapdeng kito ki bym bat shuh ia ka Niam Khasi. (Ki tymmen Khasi kiju kynnoh, “Ka jingiap kam ju thala^’). Ki daw kiba hham paw ki long ba ka jingpynleit-niam pyn- leit-rukom, lada ka long ha kano-kano ka dur, bunsien ka dawa bad ka iasnoh bad ka jinglut. Nalorkata, donkam ban pyntip ia ki kur ki kha bad ki lok ki jor ban pynkhuid ia ka met. Kawei pat ka long ka kynja jingngeit, ba don u kynja kyrwoh uba maian

hapdeng kiba im bad kiba iap, kumta kim ju leh thala ia ka met- iap. Ngi iatip ba hapdeng ki Syiem Sohra, ia ka met-iap la tyngkai bun snem namarbaka thang (cremation) k^ iaid ryngkat bad ka thung (coronation) bad kum ka nuksa, ia u Syiem Ram Sing uba la iap ha ka 23 laiong 1875, la thang haduh ka 5 bad 6 tarik Lber, 1908 da u Roba, u da shim ram Rs. 15,000.00 (khadsan hajar) na ka Sorkar bad u paid nong-on-thang u long kumba 10,000 ngut. Hapdeng ki Syiem Nongstion ruh ki ju tyngkai ia ka met-iap haduh ban da lah ban pynbiang ia ki jingdawa. Ki tymmen ki khana ba ia u Syiem Don ne Don Raja la tyngkai kumba 9 snem: ia u Mon Syiem 3 bnai bad ia u Byrson Syiem 2 bnai. Ha ki thain Nongstoin ruh ki thep hi ia ka met hapoh kn shyng-oid syriem kumba leh ha Sohra bad ki jiar ia ka pyut shapoh khyndew, tangba ki kham pyndonkam da u skop soh-riew na ka bynta ban set ia kaba pei. Ki tymmen kim shym batai eiei la ki pyndonkam ne em ia ka ngap bad u sohjew ha kaba tyngkai raet- lap, kumba leh sha ki thain Sohra. U Rthaw : Ha ki thain Lyngngam khap Garo ju jyllei bha u siej uba ki jer kyrteng u ‘Rthaw’ bad don bun ki jaka ba la tap khlaw da une u jaid siej. Ki Jaid Thien - Ki don kumba lai jaid ki thlen lum : u thlen ktieh uba thoh bthuh ; u thlen-ni ne thlen syiem uba thoh stem; u thlen-krem uba thoh-lieh thoh-iong. Ia ka khlein jong u thlen-

lum ki shna dawai» bad don kiba ngeit ba ka long dawai ruh ia kito kiba ngeit ba ki pang thlen. Kitei ki jaid thlen ki kham don kynrei sha ki thain Lyngngam. Ki Jaid Dieng : Haduh kumba 20-25 snem mynshuwa dang don bun ki dieng bah kiba sbi-piam,^ ar-piam star sha kine ki thain Lyngngam^ hynrei nadoh ba la lait kali la shitom ban iohi ia ki dieng-bab. 27 U Koh-Na-Hei : Ha kine ki thain Lyngngam, ki trai shnong Jci ialap ruh shaphang u jaid-ksuid uba tip kum u Koh-Na-Hei Uba ju paw ha ka dur kum u kulai. Unc u jaid ksuid, ki ong, lada u jliah ia uno-uno u briew, uta uba shah jliah u sah satang ka shyieng suda. Sohra : Ki don kiba batai ba kane ka shnong ka ioh ia la ka kyrteng na ka briew kaba kyrteng ka Soh-ra. Hynrei lyngba ka ji ^gthud bniah, ki lymmeii ki batai ba ka ktien ‘Ra’, bunsien ka thcw ia kaei-kaei ka bym-long bym-man, ka bym-sei-soh, ka- ba lyugki, kaba ym-Iarkam shuh bad kiba kum kita ki jingmut. Kumta, ka Sohra ka kham mut ia ka jaka kaba khlera-soh lane bym-sei-sob. Kane ka thain ka long kumta na ka jinglong ka ram-ew hi ba ka Jong ka kynja sa-tap mawsiang bad shong maw- ramsong bad ba la nang iarap ban pynlong syllen shuh-shuh ia ka da ka jingtrei ki bor ka mariang, kum uslap, u phria, kasngi, ka Iyer bad kiwei-kiwei. Lelise ki stad ram-ew ki lah ban ai jing- batai bniah shaphang ka jinglong ka ram-ew ha kane ka thain.

Ka ktien ‘Ra’ (nalor kiwei-kiwei pat ki jingmut ba ka kit), ka kit ia katei kajuh ka jingmut ha ka jingiasnoh bad ka ktien ‘Leng-ra’, ‘Nong-ra’, bad kiwei-kiwei kiba kum kita. Soh-ra-rim : Ki tymmen ki khana ba ka shnong Sohra ka ju long ha katei ka jaka naduh ki juk sbuwa ban wan poi ki Phareng. Ka don kawci ka jaka hajan ban leit sha Palong Ka Ber kaba kikhot Mawpun-Sobra-Rim, namar ki ong ba dei nang- ne ba ki iaid Jynti hyndai ban leit sha Snhra-rim. Ki tymmen ki ong ba ynda jop noh u Khadsawphra ia ka Sohra-rim ki Sohra ki la iakhun tyngeh hajan Riat Mawiew. Hangta ka don ka kha- rai shakhmat bad ka Riat Mawiew pat shadien, bad dei ynda la poi hangta ba u Khadsawphra u luin bad um nud tur shuL Ki tymmen ki iathuh ba hajan jong kane ka kharai u don uwei u mot uba ki tip kum u Mot-Ka-Iaw-Tira. Une u mot u don ha ka jaka kaba ki khot ka Maw-rin-rin, hajanjongka shnong Kyntur-sniang. U ieng ruh ha ka jaka kaba kham lum na kaba lah ban shynna ia ka Shnong Sohra kaba mynta. Ka-Rynsan-U-Buh : Katba lah ban tip, kane ka rynsan ka ioh ia la ka kyrteng na u Buh Singh Syiem, U Syiera Mawsmai uba ju leit shongkai bam Iyer ha kane ka jaka. Hadien ynda wan poi ki Sahep Ropeway, namar ba kim lait ban kynnoh Khasi Rynsan- U-Buh^ ki kynnoh pynban ‘Rang-Sna-Bo’. Nong-saw-lia : Ki tymmen ki ong ba kane ka shnong ka ioh ia la ka kyrteng namar ka jingdei sngi naduh dang step phyrngap. Ka sngi ka noh-kjat ba kane ka shnong bad ka dob ia ka naduh

ka por ba ki kjat-sngi ki dang lung bad dang sawlia. Ka jingmut 28 jong ka ktien ‘Sawlia’ ne ‘Saw-lia-lia’ ka long kaba saw malu- mala. Ka don ruh kawei ka phud hajan Pomsohmen kaba ki khot ka Um-Saw-Lia, Kham sharum jong ka Nongsawlia ka don ka ksaid kaba tip ia ka kum ka ksaid Noh-Sngi-Thiang. Ka Siat-Bakon : Ki tymmen ki khana ba ka Raj Shabong ka dei hyndai ka jaka jong ki Synteng bad u Bakon u dei u khlawait ki Synteng, uba ki ioh siat ki Shabong ha kane ka jaka. Ki tym- men ki iathuh ba ki syrwet jong kata ka thma hyndai ki dang don ha Ryngksai. Sait-Soh-Pen : La jcr kumta ia kane ka shnong namar shi- sien ha kawei ka por la jia ka nemsniew ha ka thain Sohra haduh u pud ba ki briew ki la donkam ban pynkdang ialade da u Sohpen. Ki don kiba kyllon iap ha ka por ba ki dang leit tih ia une u soh- pen bad sait ha ka wah duid kaba mih na shaphang ka dong ka- ba ynda wan ki Phareng ki pynlong ia kata kajakaka lum-jingtep Phareng. Ki sait ia ki soh halor jong ki mawsiang kiba don shi- lynter jong kane ka Phud-wah bad naduh kata ka por ki sa khot ka Sait-Soh-Pen. Nong-Wei : Ha ki thain Sohra ki ong ki ‘Nongwei’ ia ki khun soh-syiem kiba shabar ka Hima Sohra. Nong-Jan : Ka kham mut ia ki shnong kiba hajan ka Nong- bah ne ia ki briew kiba shong ha kita ki shnong synem kumba ki ong sha ki thain Jowai, ki Palat Shnong (kata ia ki briew kiba na

nongkyndong). Ra-Won : La bun snem mynshua, u la don u briew ha Jaiaw uba kyrteng u Rawon. Ki tymmen kim shym iathuh thikna nang- no une u wan ban shong shnong ha Jaiaw. U long u briew uba im da kaba khwai dohkha bad u ju leit ban pynlut ia ka miet sha ka Wah Umiam, U long u briew uba minot ha kata bad uba iaw ruh. Une, ki ong, u la pyrshang ruh ban wad jingstad da kaba leit sah sha wah bad ap ia ka por ba ka wah kan thiah, na- mar ka don ka jingngeit ba uno-uno uba ioh ban tong urn ha ka por ba ka wah ka ioh thiah, un ioh jingstad. Une u la iap ynda u la beh tymmen. Na ka kyrteng jong une u briew sa ioh kynnoh ‘Rawon’ ia uno uno u briew uba brai eh ha ka kam khwai doh- kha haduh mynta mynne. U Ra-Don : Une pat, ong ki tymmen, u long uba khlain palat ban bam mluh bad ia uno uno uba bam mluh palat ki sin ia u, U ‘Ra-don’ haduh mynta mynne. U Ra-Jon : la une pat, ki tymmen ki khana ba u long u ba- riam rynjain haduh katta-katta. Kumta ia uno-uno uba leh ryn- jain ki sin ne pyniasyriem kum u Rajon haduh mynta mynne. 29 Ka Surok-Tup : Ki lymmen ki iathuh ba ha ka por ka thma Synteng, ka Sorkar, ynda haba ka la shem ba jwat ban jop, kam banse ban pyrshang ban leit lam noh sa da ki tup na Laban (Shillong) sha Juwei (Jowai) lyngba ka surok ba la da shna kyr- pang. La leit rah ia kine ki tup ; hynrei shuwa ban ioh ban pyn-

donkam, ka lap bakut noh ka thma. Ia kata ka surok ki khot ia ka, ka Surok-tup. Kane ka surok ka iabud lang bad ka surok kulai tangba don pat ki bynta ba ka kdat lad. — : 0 :— Duitara : Ym lah ban ong thikna mynno ki Kbasi ki la sdang ban pyndonkam ia kane ka jingtem Duitara. Ka jingshisha ka sah tang ba ka long kawei na ki jingtem kiba la rim bha. la ka Duitara bunsien ki ju tern ne bsiat ksai ba kan sawa ar-synrap nc ar-tara bad, imat, dei na kane ka daw ba ka sawa ar-sur ne ar-tar ba la jer ia ka, Ka Duitara. Kum ban kyrshan ia kane ka jing- ong, ki tymmen ki ialap ruh ba ha ki por hyndai ki don ki briew kiba lem ia ka jingtem shi-sur kaba ki tip kum ka Ek-tara. Ia ki jingrwai kristan (Khasi Hymn) ha ka ktien Khasi la pyn- mih nyngkong eh da u Sahep Thomas Jones I ha ka snem 1846 bud sa ka kot jingrwai ‘Khasi Hymn Book’ ha ka 1853 da u Rev. William Lewis. Hadien la nang pynbun sha ka 75 tylli ki jing- rwai bad la pynmih ha ki snem 1860 bad 1866 da u Rev. Thomas Jones II. Nangta pat la pynmih sa kawei ka kot jingrwai kaba kham heh ha ka snem 1876 da u Rev. Hugh Roberts. Katba lah ban lum jingtip, ia ka rukom ban synran ia ki jingrwai ha iing- mane da ki kynja jingtem-jingput la sdang pyndonkam nyngkong eh ha Nongsawlia ha ki por khyndiat snem shua u Jumai Bah 1897 bad ka jingtem ba la pyndonkam dei ka folding organ ba wanrah bad tern u Missionary uba trei ha ki thain Shilot (Sylhet). Lehse, u lah ban dei u Sahep Pongwern Jones. Ha lingmanc Mawkhar

la pyndonkam nyngkong eh da ka organ ha ka por I Miss A. W. Thomas, kata hapdeng ki snem 1897-1900. (La sot na ka Jing- kynthoh u Rangbah W. R. Laitflang kum u Chairman halor ka paper XII ka subject : “Literature and Music” ba la pule da u Rangbah V. C. Bareh ha ka Symposium on Khasi Literature ha ka 27th May, 1975 hapoh ka jingpeit ka N.E.H.U.) Ka Khlam : Ka khlam-ka-ngoh : Ki tymmen ki ong ka khlam ia kano kano ka jingpang kaba ktah ne sar ne pyniap bun ki briew — ka jingpang kaba la khie ha ka dur ka epidemic. Ki tymmen ki kynnoh ka khlam ka ngob, kata ba ka long kaei-kaei ka bym ju jia koit barabor, hynrei ka wan ‘Jngoh’ ne ‘Ngoh’ teng- teng. Kawei na ki jaid jingpang kaba ju khie ba kane ka dur ka long kata kaba ki khot ka pang-iap-them lane ka kynja cholera. La jer kyrteng kumta namar ki tymmen ki ong ba kham bunsien 30 ki briew ki ju kham ioh kem ia kane ka jingpang ha ki jaka them jaka thor ne Ri-Them. Ha ka khlam bah (lyngba ka pang-iap- them) kaba la khie ha Laban (Shillong) ha ka snem 1879, la ong ba la iap 144 ngut tang ha shnong Mawkhar. la kiba iap ki pyn- kit ia ki halor ki kali-bordi, ki tap da ki jain lieh bad leit rah sha rud-nong shaphang Mawlai. Katta ka trei ka jingshepticng ia ki briew ba hapdeng kata ka jinglyngwit, la don teng ba wat ia kiba ym pat dkut mynsiem ruh la rah bad pynkit lang ia ki bad kiba iap ; hynrei sngewbiria, ba wei ‘bym pat lut hi la u khaw’, don hi uba lait im tang kat ban sah iathuhkhana. Ki tymmen Khasi,

khamtam ha ki por kiba dang shitom ban ioh jingsumar kumba long ha ki por mynta, ki don ka jingpyrkhat tyndi-tynda ba ka long kaei-kaei kaba sngewsang-sot sngewngiew ruh ban iap da ka khlam, namar ba bunsien kim lah ne ym shah lynti satia ban da pynleit niam ne leh niam leh rukom thikna. Lehse, kane ka lah ban long kawci na ki daw ba sa mih ka kynja kticn-tim — ‘U ban da shoh ka khlam’ lane 'Ka ban da shoh ka ngoh’ ne haba kren shai, U khun ka pap ; U ban da shoh ka ngoh. Ha ka pyrkhat Khasi, niar eh ban don kaba kin sngewbuh-khoh ne niew palat nalor kata kaba haba u briew u iap, pynban ym lah satia ban pynleit niam. Ki tymmen, ia uno-uno uba iap khlem pynleit niam shuh tdot, ki ju ong — ‘Uta u la ryngkat ka mrad’. Ka Adong bad Bidong : Ki tymmen ki ju kham pyndonkam ia ka ktien ‘ADONG’ ban mut ba ka long ka jingmana ne ka jingkhang kaba dei lut ia baroh kiba hap ha kajuh ka jylli, lada ka shnong ka ilaka ne ka hima. Ka Bidong : La ju kham pyndonkam ban thew ia ka jing- mana tangba kaba ym da pyrkhing eh kat ka ‘ADONG’. Ka ktien ‘Adong’ ka kham iajan ka jingmut bad ka ktien Phareng ; PROHIBITION. ‘BIDONG’ ka kham iasyriem jingmut bad ka ktien RESTRICTION. — ; 0 :— Ki Tymmen Saw-Khmat : Ki don ki briew kiba kham mih phylla kiba don ka sap kaba kham pher ba ki lab ban iohi ia kiei- kiei palat ban ia kiba bun ki para-briew ki iohi. Kumban ai nu-

ksa, ki lah ban iohi ia kiei-kiei ki ban sajia, ki iohi ia ka jing- iaid-jingieng jong ki briew kiba ym don rta shuh, kata kiba Iajan iap. la ki kynja briew kiba kum kine, ki tymmen ki sin ia kL ‘KI TYMMEN SAW-KHMAT’. Kum ban shu ong ar-khmat ki iohi kumba ia iohi lem ki para briew baroh, bad ki don pat sa ar ki khmat kiba ngi ngim iohi, bad la ngeit ba da kita ki iohi ia kiei-kiei kumba la kdew ha neng. Haba shu kren kyllum, kine ki Tymmen Saw-Khmat ki don ka jingiasyriem bad kita kiba ki Phareng ki khot ki ‘Clairvoyant*. 31 ttyndai ki lathuhkhana ba don u ‘Luna Kulai’ uba hajan jong ka shnong Mawsmai kata hamar Nongthymmal ha Sohra. Ki ksuid ki ju pynlong Dorbar halor jong une u lum bad kine ki ^van sha Dorbar ki da shong halOr ki kulai. Kinc ki jaid briew kiba ong ki Tymmen Saw-Khmat, ki iohi ia kinc ki ksuid ba ki iashong kulai bad dei na kata ka daw ba ki sa jcr ia uta u lum, ‘Lum Kulai’ haduh mynta mynne. U Thuia : la ki sner heh ba ki pyndonkam ha u Thuia, ki ioh ia ki na u Sim Ryphud ne u kynja Phud ne kynja sim-puh* dohkha uba ju kham shem kynrei ha ki bir (kiba mynta ki la hap noh shapoh Bangladesh). la u Thuia ki shna da ki sner jong u Sim-Riah-Sei ne u Sim Rynhiaw. la ki iop-iop sner pat ba ki pynnoh, ki shna da ki sr.er syiar. Katba lah ban tip, ka dor u- wci u Thuia ka long antad 50 tyngka kata kumba 25 ne 30 snem mynshuwa.

Pen Ryngkew : U don u jait Sohpen uba paw sha Ryngkew, kata uba la paw lypa ha khyndew, ia une u jait soh, ki ong u Soh-Pcn-Ryngkew ne lyngkot u Pen Ryngkew. Na kajinglong une u jaid Soh Pen, sa ioh ia ka rukom kren ne Phawar ‘Ka Shun ruh ym pat pei, la paw pen ryngkew’. Ha kiwei pat ki ktien ka mut ba ka kam ka lah da paw shabar, haba ki briew ki nang pyr- khat badang lah ban buhrieh. Lehsc ka jingmut ka iasyriem bad kaba ki Phareng ki ong, ‘The cat is out c f The bag’. Dungkura : Ki Khasi hyndai kim ju tip satia ia ka rukom iashoh iadat da kaba shu sah shu ia bok ne ‘boxing’ kumba ong ki Phareng. Ki Khasi ki tip tang ka ialympat, ki ia thab bad kiwei-kiwei kiba kum kiia. Dei ynda ki la iohi ia ki shipai doh- lieh kaba ki dkhar ki ong ki ‘Gora’ bad kiba ki Khasi ki kynnoh ‘Kura’ ba ki ia bok, ba ki Khasi ruh ki sa pyrthuh ban iashoh kumba ialeh ki shipai Kura, la kane ka rukom iashoh da kaba shu ia bok kaba wanrah ki Phareng, ki sa ong kaba sah-kura ne dung-kura kaba mut ban sah ne ban ia ‘box’ kumba ialeh ki shi- pai Gora, bad kham hadicn-hadien ki sa shu ong lyngkot noh ka- ba ‘kura’, Ha ki por ba ka sor ka dang don ha Sohra, ka don kawei ka madan kaba ki shipai Phareng ki pynshad shipai (Parade) ia ki shipai Gora ne Kura. Nangta sa ioh kynnoh ia kane ka madan kum KA MADAN PYNSHAD GORA, ne pynshad Kura haduh mynta mynne. Don pat ruh kiba ia kane kajuh ka madan pyn- shad Ghora ne Khora kata ban mut ka madan pynshad kulai na-

mar ki dkhar ia u kulai ki ong Ghora, hynrei imat ka jingbatai kaba kham tynrai ka long kumba, la batai sha khmat. Hadien- hadien, don ruh kiba kynnoh Pynshad-khurai. 32 Sah-Khir : Ki tymmen Khasi hyndai baba shun iano-iano ki ong ‘To kata, ngan shu sah khir nob’. ka shaiong ne dum ka jingmut-jingpyrkhaU 40 Kup-shiliaog sem-shiliang : Ym lah ban ong thikna naduh mynno la pyndonkam ia kine ki ktien, hynrei katba lah ban tip pateng la pyndonkam ia ki ha ka Soskular jong ki Syiem Sohra. Mynta myn- ne, lehse, kane ka kynticn kup-shiliang sem-shiliang kan iasyriem katto-katne ka jingmut kaba ki ong mynta ha ka Phareng, Econo- mically weaker section of the society. haduh ba i kum ban khoi sa ka doh. Ki Bok-Wala : Hyndaihadienba lakynriah kaSor na S”)hra sha Laban (ngi ong Shyllong mynta), ki ju don ki no.igkhaii ne nongdie jingdje kiba rah la ki mar ki mata bad ki luri lura baroh tang hap^h ka synduk (box), ki da iaid tyrwa kyllengka Sor. ‘ADJUTANT’. Ki tymmen ki iathuh badon bun ki Khasi, kham- tam kilo kiba hapoh ki Ilaka kiba don ka jingiajuh-lok bad ki Phareng, kiba niewkor katta-katta ia ka rukom im (discipline) ki shipai, ba ki don ruh kiba da ang-nud ba ki khun-shynrang jong ki kin long kum ki shipai. Te, kum ka sakhi ne ka dak, ki pynsnoh bad ka ktien ‘Ton’ ha ka kyrteng jong ki khun kum, ‘Rulon’, Jiton, Saton, etc. Na kane ka daw ka sa kham kynrei ka “Ton” bad ki shynrang, bad kham niar ch ban lap ia ka ha ki kynthei. — :o:— Thad : La ju kham ong ia ka kynja madan ka bym don jing- kah, kaba siik ban iohi shynna jngai bad sawangkdar. pyniaw, pynsti bad kiwci-kiwei kiba kum kita. Don pat ruh ki ktien kiba kynnoh syricm kumici, tangba kim kit satia ia ka jingmut. Pynshad-Khaw-Iang : U khaw-Iang u long u kynja jing- thung uba u sla jong u long syricm ia u sla-siej. Une u man bha ha ki thain War. Ki ong kumne, ym dei tang ia u briew uba la buaid kiad shi- slia, hynrei ba u leh syriem ia u nongbuaid-kyiad kumba ki kyn- noh ia uno-uno ba u leh kumba khie-bhang, kata ba u briew u leh syriem kumba leh u briew uba dih ne uba la buaid bhang. Teh Mu-Sorkar Laoe Teh-Mu-Sorkha : Kane ka long ka ru- kom ban teh ne adong ne bidong ne pyrkhing da ka ain ia uno u- no u briew ba um lah ban iaid mon, ieng mon na ka daw jong

kano ma kano ka kam bc-ain ka ba u la leh. Ka long ka kynja jingmaham. U briew uba byrngem byrsit iano iano, lah ban teh ia u da ka aifi, ba lada jia ei-ei ia uta ne kita kiba u bymgem, ka jingjia kaba sniew kan long halor ka khlieh jong u. 43 Mynsain : Ka Mynsain ka long ka bynta jong ka khlaw ne ka bri ba la pynkhuid ne ieh kyrpang syriem ia kaba ki Phareng ki ong ka Tire-Line’. Kane ka long ruh ka jingiapynkhlad pud (no man’s land) hapdeng ki marjan. Ki tymmen ki batai ba hyn- dai ka ju don ka jaka ba la pyllait kyrpang hapdeng uwei u maw- bri bad uwei pat. Ngi ioh ia kane ka kyrteng Mynsain, lehse ka lah ban long na ka daw ba ki da sain-ding. Khan-Shanam : Kane ka long kawei na ki rukom khan ha kaba u nongkhan u pyndonkam ia ka shanam (kynja khiew ne jyndiang kaba la ju kham shna da ka rnong-Jieh ban buh shun). ka shanam ha ka por ba u khan u kyntip. Ki khan shanam kum ha ka por jah masi, ne shuwa ban ktah kti ne kynrup ia uno-uno u briew bad ha kiwei-kiwei de ki kam. Morsha : Ki ju kham kynnoh tih ne tei Morsha. Kane ka long ka rukom tih, ne tei, ne seng ia ka khyndew ha kata ka ru- kom ban iada ia ka um ba kan ym lah ban shop ne pyiijulor ia ki pynthor. Ka Morsha ka long kum ka kynton ne kynroh da ka maw bad ki stong. la ka kper ne ka lum kseh ban ithuh ia ka jong bad ban iada na ka jingtur ki jingri, ki trai khyndew ki ju shna ne kynroh ne kynton morsha. La kham pyndonkam paid- bah, ha ka por mynta, ia kane ka ktien ‘Morsha’ da ki briew kiba shong ha ki thain Jaintia. Shala : Ka jingmut jong kane ka ktien ka kham thew ia kaei-kaei ba bym long satia kumba ka dei ban long, kata kum kaba kdor, kaba lah-shiliang, ka bym hap matang, ka bym beit, kaba kyllain bad kiba kum kita ki jingmut. Ki ju kham pyndon- kam paidbah ha kaba kren shaphang ka lyntang ne dieng ha kaba shna ling shna sem. Ki ong ruh uba shala khmat ban mut ba ki khmat baroh ar ki don ka jingshong-pher haei-re-haei. Ki khmat uba shala ki thew sha kamon, hynrei u mut sha ka diang. 44 Jaiaw : U JaiaW u long u jynthung uba san haduh kumba 10 haduh 15 phut. spah kiba leh maloi da u kynja bilor ne rupa langba kham niar kum kine. U Lum-Rai-Kynthong : Une u lum u don hajan ka jaka ba ju lip kum ka Sung. Hangne ki hati (khamtam ha ki phew snem ba la leit noh) ki ju suh khlieh bad kjit ia ka um-roluh hapoh thwei, nangta ki sa mih shabar. 45 U Lyngka-Phra-Dong : Ha ki por kiba khani mynshuwa, ki tymmen ki smat bha ban pyndonkam ia une u jait Shalyngka. dai khamtam sha ki thain Sohra. Wait-Lyngngan Ne Wait-Lyngkut : Kane ka long ka jait wait kaba heh had khia. Kam don khmut satia kum ka wait-khmut ne wait-bnoh. Na kane sa ioh ktien kynnoh ka shuri ka jamdor. — : 0 ;— A6 Ki Nongriam-Pukiii Ne Nongsiat Pukni : Katto katne phew snem ba la leit noh bad khamtam ha ki por bad jaka ba ka jing- iasiatkhnam ne ka rong biria ka dangrasong bha(nalor kiwei pat ki rukom pyndonkam ia u khnam) ka jingdawa khnam hapdeng u khun Khasi Khara ka long kaba jur bha. nongpur-khnam, Ha ki jaka bashaphang lum, kham bunsien ia ka ryntieh ki shna na u siej raniai ; ia u ksai siej ki shna na uba ki khot paidbah u siej bri namar u kham jwat ; ia u khnam patki kham shna na u stew. Nong-Kylla-Khnam : Lada ha ka iasiat ’nam-hali ne iasiat ’nam spah, ki don ki briew, kham bunsien, sawngut na kawei ka liang kiba da jied kyrpang kiba ki khot ki Nongniew-khnam. Ki- ne ki briew ki niew ia ki khnam shwa ban siat. Ki nongniew ki- ba na ka liang jong u ’nam-iong ki niew kylla ia kiba na ka liang u ’nam-saw, kumjuh ruh kiba na ka liang u ’nam-saw ki niew kylla ia kiba na ka liang u ’nam-iong shuwa ban iasiat. Dei na kane ka daw ba ki sa kynnoh ia ki kum ki nongkylla khnam. Ha ki juk kiba mynshuwa, kata haba kim pat pyndonkam ia ki baje, ki shu ai dak ban sdang da kaba ong ‘sdang’ ne ‘siat’, bad ynda haba la lut khnam pat ki khang noh da kaba ong ‘sangeh’. Haba ki siat-thrap ne siat-brap, baroh ki nongiasiat kim ioh kat- juh tylli ki khnam. Kham bunsien, ki ju ai kham bun tylli ki khnam ha u nongsiat uba kham tbit bad uba sting kti, kaba mut uba kham stad ban siat. Namarba ka liang kaba la lut khnam ka khang noh ia kawei pat ka liang ban siat. Hadien hadien ia kane ka rukom la shu tip lyngkot kum ka Khang-khnam. Kane ka bynta : hap khang khnam, ka long kaba ki da leh sumar bad ka-

ba ym dei ruh ban bakla. Shisyn-ong kyllum, ki don bun kiei kiei kiba phylla bad maian kiba iasnoh bad ka jingiasiat, tangba sngew kynduh-mawsiang ban pyrshang ai ia kino kino ki jingbatai kiba thiicna. U Dak Lane U Nongphet-Dak (Postal Runner) : Kumne ki ju khot ia u briew uba la thung da ka Sorkar na ka bynta ban leitai ia ka dak (kaba bunsien ka kham thew eh ia ki kynja shithi ne parcel ne kiba kum kita ki jait) na Laban sha Guwahati, ne La- ban sha Sohra, ne Laban sha Jowai nalor kiwei kiwei pat ki jaka. Une u dak bunsien u ju march shop-shop baroh shilynter lynti ryngkat bad la ka jingkit bad u dieng-duh uba la teh bad iwei i shakuriaw ba riew khriaw-khriaw katba u dang march ha lynti. Ia ka rukom jingmarch ne jingphet Jong u dang iohsngew ba ialap haduh mynta mynne da kite ki briew kiba la kham iawba ki ong, “Mynta ha kine ki sngi ba bun kam eh, nga shu march kumba march u Dak lane phet kumba phet u Dak’^ Kane ka rukom

phet dak sha Sohra ka la duh la slem, kaba sha Jowai ka dang duh dang kham shibit. U Dak uba dei sha lynti Jowai u ju ia- kylliang ia ka dak ha Mawryngkneng bad uba wan na Jowai. Sha Sohra pat ki ong don arngut kiba leit na Laban bad arngut pat kiba wan shaw na Sohra. Ki buh arngut dei na ka daw ba kin kham iashngain, ne ka lah ban long bakham bun ka dak sha ka- ne ka lynti.
